  return isValidPlacement(a.personId, a.positionId, a.startSlot, { durSlots:newSlotCount, excludeAssignmentId:a.id, allowSelfOverride:growing });
}
function resizeAssignment(assignmentId, newSlotCount){
  const check = isValidResize(assignmentId, newSlotCount);
  if(!check.ok) return false;
  applyResizeWithDisplacement(assignmentId, newSlotCount);
  return true;
}
/* Grows (or shrinks) an assignment to newSlotCount. When growing, any of the SAME
   person's other assignments that fall in the newly-claimed span are displaced —
   fully removed if entirely covered, or trimmed to their leftover tail if only
   partially covered — rather than blocking the resize. Assumes isValidResize already
   passed (so nothing locked is being displaced). */
function applyResizeWithDisplacement(assignmentId, newSlotCount){
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===assignmentId);
  if(!a) return false;
  if(newSlotCount>a.slotCount){
    const oldEnd = a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1;
    const newEnd = a.startSlot+newSlotCount-1;
    const toRemove = [];
    state.assignments.forEach(other=>{
      if(other.id===a.id || other.personId!==a.personId) return;
      const oEnd = other.startSlot+other.slotCount-1;
      if(oEnd<=oldEnd || other.startSlot>newEnd) return; // outside the growth zone entirely
      if(oEnd<=newEnd){
        toRemove.push(other.id); // fully covered by growth, remove entirely
      } else {
        // partially covered: keep only the leftover tail beyond the new end
        other.startSlot = newEnd+1;
        other.slotCount = oEnd-(newEnd+1)+1;
      }
    });
    if(toRemove.length){
      const filtered = state.assignments.filter(x=>!toRemove.includes(x.id));
      state.assignments = filtered;
      activeSchedule().assignments = filtered;
    }
  }
  a.slotCount = newSlotCount;
  return true;
}

/* ---------------- Preferred-rule matching (soft/suggestion side) ---------------- */
function matchesSequencePreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots){
  if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
  const order = rule.relative.order || 'after';
  const maxGap = rule.relative.maxGapMinutes;
  const otherTarget = rule.relative.otherPosition || {mode:'any'};
  const candStart = occupiedSlots[0], candEnd = occupiedSlots[occupiedSlots.length-1];
  return state.assignments.some(a=>{
    if(a.personId!==personId) return false;
    if(!positionMatchesTarget(otherTarget, a.positionId)) return false;
    const aStart=a.startSlot, aEnd=a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1;
    if(order==='after') return orderRelationHolds(aEnd, candStart, maxGap);
    if(order==='before') return orderRelationHolds(candEnd, aStart, maxGap);
    return orderRelationHolds(aEnd, candStart, maxGap) || orderRelationHolds(candEnd, aStart, maxGap);
  });
}
function matchesTogetherPreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots){
  const otherTarget = rule.relative.otherPerson || {mode:'any'};
  const matchesPrimary = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId);
  const matchesOther = personMatchesTarget(otherTarget, personId);
  if(!matchesPrimary && !matchesOther) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
  const counterpartTarget = matchesPrimary ? otherTarget : rule.person;
  const counterpartIds = state.people.filter(p=>p.id!==personId && personMatchesTarget(counterpartTarget, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
  return state.assignments.some(a=>counterpartIds.includes(a.personId) && a.positionId===positionId && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>occupiedSlots.includes(s)));
}
function preferredMatchesFor(personId, positionId, startSlot){
  const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
  const occ = range(startSlot, startSlot+durSlots-1);
  return state.rules.filter(rule=>{
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='preferred' || rule.effect!=='require') return false;
    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      const t = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      if(t==='sequence') return matchesSequencePreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ);
      if(t==='together') return matchesTogetherPreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ);
      return false;
    }
    if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
    if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
    return occ.some(s=>slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, s));
  });
}
/* Which active PREFERRED-forbid rules a candidate placement would violate. isValidPlacement
   only ever enforces REQUIRED-forbid rules as a hard block, so without this the solver has
   no way to know a placement breaks a preferred rule at all — it can (and did) freely create
   preferred-rule violations whenever nothing required stopped it. This mirrors the forbid-
   checking loop in isValidPlacement, but scoped to preferred strength, and returns the list
   instead of blocking, so callers can prefer alternatives without treating it as a hard fail. */
function preferredForbidHits(personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlotsOverride){
  const durSlots = durSlotsOverride!==undefined ? durSlotsOverride : positionDurationSlots(positionId);
  const occupied = range(startSlot, startSlot+durSlots-1);
  return state.rules.filter(rule=>{
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='preferred' || rule.effect!=='forbid' || rule.kind==='unfilledAllowance') return false;
    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      const relType = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      if(relType==='sequence') return violatesSequenceRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied);
      if(relType==='together') return violatesTogetherRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied);
      if(relType==='consecutive') return violatesConsecutiveRule(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots);
      if(relType==='totalLimit') return violatesTotalLimitRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied);
      if(relType==='crossSchedule') return violatesCrossScheduleRule(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots);
      if(relType==='swap') return violatesSwapRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied);
      return false;
    }
    if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
    if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
    return occupied.some(s=>slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, s));
  });
}

/* Splits a staggered-start rule's time range (rule.slot — any/id/range, reused here as
   "the specified time range") into consecutive, non-overlapping windows of intervalMinutes
   each. Each window needs at least one qualifying assignment to START somewhere inside it —
   this is the "someone must start every X minutes" coverage requirement, not a per-placement
   forbid check, so it's handled as its own coverage pass rather than via violatesXRule(). */
function staggeredStartWindows(rule){
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  const rangeSlots = targetSlotIndices(rule.slot, totalSlots);
  if(rangeSlots.length===0) return [];
  const rangeStart = rangeSlots[0], rangeEnd = rangeSlots[rangeSlots.length-1];
  const intervalMinutes = Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Number(rule.relative.intervalMinutes)||15);
  const intervalSlots = Math.max(1, Math.round(intervalMinutes/SLOT_MINUTES));
  const windows = [];
  for(let s=rangeStart; s<=rangeEnd; s+=intervalSlots){
    windows.push({ start:s, end: Math.min(rangeEnd, s+intervalSlots-1) });
  }
  return windows;
}

/* ---------------- Violations / coverage ---------------- */
function computeViolations(){
  const out = [];
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active || rule.kind==='unfilledAllowance') continue; // a solver setting, not a placement constraint — never produces violations

    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      const relType = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      if(relType==='staggeredStart'){
        // Coverage-style requirement, not a per-assignment forbid check — only meaningful
        // (and only currently enforced) as a required "must be scheduled" rule.
        if(rule.effect==='require' && rule.strength==='required'){
          for(const win of staggeredStartWindows(rule)){
            const covered = state.assignments.some(a=>
              personMatchesTarget(rule.person, a.personId) &&
              positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId) &&
              a.startSlot>=win.start && a.startSlot<=win.end);
            if(!covered) out.push({ rule, slot:win.start, windowEnd:win.end, kind:'uncovered' });
          }
        }
        continue;
      }
      if(rule.effect!=='forbid') continue; // required+require relative rules (other than staggeredStart) aren't auto-checked for coverage (see docs)
      for(const a of state.assignments){
        const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
        let violated = false;
        if(relType==='sequence') violated = violatesSequenceRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        else if(relType==='together') violated = violatesTogetherRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        else if(relType==='consecutive') violated = violatesConsecutiveRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, a.startSlot, a.slotCount, a.id);
        else if(relType==='totalLimit') violated = violatesTotalLimitRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        else if(relType==='crossSchedule') violated = violatesCrossScheduleRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, a.startSlot, a.slotCount);
        else if(relType==='swap') violated = violatesSwapRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        if(violated) out.push({ rule, assignment:a, kind:'forbidden-but-scheduled' });
      }
      continue;
    }

    if(rule.effect==='forbid'){
      for(const a of state.assignments){
        if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, a.personId)) continue;
        if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId)) continue;
        const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
        const targets = new Set(targetSlotIndices(rule.slot, totalSlots));
        if(occ.some(s=>targets.has(s))){
          out.push({ rule, assignment:a, kind:'forbidden-but-scheduled' });
        }
      }
    } else if(rule.effect==='require' && rule.strength==='required'){
      const targets = targetSlotIndices(rule.slot, totalSlots);
      const isAnyWithCount = rule.person && rule.person.mode==='any';
      const countRange = isAnyWithCount ? (rule.person.count || {min:1, max:1}) : null;
      for(const s of targets){
        const matchingPeople = new Set(
          state.assignments
            .filter(a=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, a.personId) && positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId) && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s))
            .map(a=>a.personId)
        );
        if(isAnyWithCount){
          if(matchingPeople.size < countRange.min) out.push({ rule, slot:s, kind:'uncovered' });
          else if(matchingPeople.size > countRange.max) out.push({ rule, slot:s, kind:'overcapacity' });
        } else if(matchingPeople.size < 1){
          out.push({ rule, slot:s, kind:'uncovered' });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage(){
  return computeViolations().filter(v=>v.kind==='uncovered').map(v=>({ rule:v.rule, slot:v.slot, windowEnd:v.windowEnd }));
}

/* Auto-materialize fully-specific required "must be scheduled" rules
   (exact person + exact position + exact slot, standard kind only) as
   confirmed assignments, so the chart reflects required rules immediately. */
function syncDirectRequiredAssignments(){
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='required' || rule.effect!=='require' || rule.kind==='relative' || rule.kind==='unfilledAllowance') continue;
    if(rule.person.mode!=='id' || rule.position.mode!=='id' || rule.slot.mode!=='id') continue;
    const already = state.assignments.some(a=>
      a.personId===rule.person.value && a.positionId===rule.position.value &&
      assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(rule.slot.value));
    if(already) continue;
    const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(rule.position.value);
    const starts = candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget({mode:'id', value:rule.slot.value}, durSlots, totalSlots);
    for(const startSlot of starts){
      const check = isValidPlacement(rule.person.value, rule.position.value, startSlot);
      if(check.ok){
        state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:rule.person.value, positionId:rule.position.value, startSlot, slotCount:durSlots });
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ---------------- Suggestions (preferred rules) ---------------- */
function computeSuggestions(){
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  const seen = new Map();
  function tryAdd(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot){
    const key = `${personId}|${positionId}|${startSlot}`;
    if(state.rejectedSuggestions.has(key)) return;
    const check = isValidPlacement(personId, positionId, startSlot);
    if(!check.ok) return;
    const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
    if(!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, { key, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots, ruleIds:new Set() });
    seen.get(key).ruleIds.add(rule.id);
  }

  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='preferred' || rule.effect!=='require' || rule.kind==='unfilledAllowance') continue;

    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      const relType = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      if(relType!=='sequence' && relType!=='together') continue;
      const people = state.people.filter(p=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      const positions = state.positions.filter(p=>positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      for(const personId of people){
        for(const positionId of positions){
          const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
          for(const startSlot of range(0, totalSlots-durSlots)){
            const occ = range(startSlot, startSlot+durSlots-1);
            const already = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===personId && a.positionId===positionId && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>occ.includes(s)));
            if(already) continue;
            const matched = relType==='sequence'
              ? matchesSequencePreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ)
              : matchesTogetherPreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ);
            if(matched) tryAdd(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot);
          }
        }
      }
      continue;
    }

    const targets = targetSlotIndices(rule.slot, totalSlots);
    const isAnyWithCount = rule.person && rule.person.mode==='any';
    const countMax = isAnyWithCount && rule.person.count ? rule.person.count.max : 1;
    for(const s of targets){
      const matchingCount = state.assignments.filter(a=>
        personMatchesTarget(rule.person, a.personId) &&
        positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId) &&
        assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s)).length;
      if(matchingCount>=countMax) continue;
      const people = state.people.filter(p=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      const positions = state.positions.filter(p=>positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      for(const personId of people){
        for(const positionId of positions){
          const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
          const starts = candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget({mode:'id', value:s}, durSlots, totalSlots);
          for(const startSlot of starts) tryAdd(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return Array.from(seen.values()).map(v=>({ ...v, ruleIds: Array.from(v.ruleIds) }));
}

/* ---------------- Constraint hot-spots (decision prioritization) ---------------- */
function computeHotSpots(){
  const slots = getSlots();
  const results = [];
  for(const person of state.people){
    for(const slot of slots){
      const covered = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(slot.index));
      if(covered) continue;
      let impact = 0;
      for(const rule of state.rules){
        if(!rule.active || rule.kind==='unfilledAllowance') continue;
        const personHit = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, person.id) ||
          (rule.kind==='relative' && rule.relative && rule.relative.otherPerson && personMatchesTarget(rule.relative.otherPerson, person.id));
        if(!personHit) continue;
        const isStaggered = rule.kind==='relative' && rule.relative && rule.relative.type==='staggeredStart';
        const slotHit = (rule.kind==='relative' && !isStaggered) ? true : slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, slot.index);
        if(!slotHit) continue;
        let weight = 1;
        if(rule.position && rule.position.mode!=='id') weight += 1;
        if(rule.person && rule.person.mode!=='id') weight += 1;
        if(rule.kind==='relative') weight += 1;
        if(rule.strength==='required') weight += 1;
        impact += weight;
      }
      if(impact>0) results.push({ personId: person.id, slot: slot.index, impact });
    }
  }
  return results.sort((a,b)=>b.impact-a.impact).slice(0,8);
}

/* ---------------- Solver (required rules only) ---------------- */
function candidatesForCoverage(rule, slot, windowEnd){
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  const people = state.people.filter(p=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
  const positions = state.positions.filter(p=>positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
  const isStaggered = rule.kind==='relative' && rule.relative && rule.relative.type==='staggeredStart';
  const out = [];
  for(const personId of people){
    for(const positionId of positions){
      const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
      // A staggered-start window needs a start slot ANYWHERE inside it, not an assignment
      // occupying one particular slot — a different notion of "coverage" than the standard
      // per-slot rules below, which candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget is built for.
      const starts = isStaggered
        ? range(Math.max(0, slot), Math.min(totalSlots-durSlots, windowEnd!==undefined ? windowEnd : slot))
        : candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget({mode:'id', value:slot}, durSlots, totalSlots);
      for(const startSlot of starts){
        const check = isValidPlacement(personId, positionId, startSlot);
        if(check.ok) out.push({ personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ================================================================
   UNDO
   Snapshot-based: captures the active schedule's mutable state
   (assignments, locks, hidden people) before an action, so a single
   Ctrl+Z (or the Undo button) reverts the last chart-affecting change.
   ================================================================ */
var undoStack = [];
const MAX_UNDO = 30;
function pushUndoSnapshot(){
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  undoStack.push({
    scheduleId: sched.id,
    assignments: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sched.assignments)),
    lockedPeople: Array.from(sched.lockedPeople),
    lockedSlots: Array.from(sched.lockedSlots),
    lockedCells: Array.from(sched.lockedCells),
    hiddenPeople: Array.from(sched.hiddenPeople),
  });
  if(undoStack.length > MAX_UNDO) undoStack.shift();
}
function undo(){
  if(undoStack.length===0){ showToast('Nothing to undo.'); return; }
  const snap = undoStack.pop();
  const sched = state.schedules.find(s=>s.id===snap.scheduleId);
  if(!sched){ showToast("Can't undo — that schedule no longer exists."); return; }
  sched.assignments = snap.assignments;
  sched.lockedPeople = new Set(snap.lockedPeople);
  sched.lockedSlots = new Set(snap.lockedSlots);
  sched.lockedCells = new Set(snap.lockedCells);
  sched.hiddenPeople = new Set(snap.hiddenPeople);
  if(state.activeScheduleId !== sched.id){
    setActiveSchedule(sched.id);
  } else {
    state.assignments = sched.assignments;
    state.lockedPeople = sched.lockedPeople;
    state.lockedSlots = sched.lockedSlots;
    state.lockedCells = sched.lockedCells;
    state.hiddenPeople = sched.hiddenPeople;
    renderAll();
  }
  showToast('Undid last change.');
}

function shuffleArray(arr){
  const a = arr.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1; i>0; i--){
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
    const tmp = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = tmp;
  }
  return a;
}

/* Tiles every remaining empty slot (respecting locks when asked) with some valid
   position, preferring options that also satisfy preferred rules, so "fill unlocked"
   and "fill all" leave no gaps — only required-rule placement is exempt from this. */
/* Resolves one person's effective "acceptable gap" thresholds from the global default
   plus any active unfilledAllowance rules that apply to them. Reuses the same must/can't/
   should/shouldn't framing as every other rule shape: a require-flavored allowance rule
   can only RAISE a threshold (guarantees at least this much slack), a forbid-flavored one
   can only LOWER it (caps it, even below the global default) — so if two rules disagree,
   the forbid side wins, matching how forbid generally trumps require elsewhere here.
   'perInstance' governs any single contiguous gap ("at a time"); 'total' is a cumulative
   per-schedule budget ("throughout the day") that starts at 0 unless a rule grants some. */
function personGapAllowance(personId){
  let perInstance = Number(state.settings.maxUnfilledMinutes)||0;
  let total = 0;
  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active || rule.kind!=='unfilledAllowance') continue;
    if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) continue;
    const minutes = Math.max(0, Number(rule.minutes)||0);
    if(rule.scope==='total') total = rule.effect==='forbid' ? Math.min(total, minutes) : Math.max(total, minutes);
    else perInstance = rule.effect==='forbid' ? Math.min(perInstance, minutes) : Math.max(perInstance, minutes);
  }
  return { perInstance: Math.max(0, perInstance), total: Math.max(0, total) };
}
function fillAllGaps(sched, respectLocks){
  const slots = getSlots();
  const visiblePeople = shuffleArray(state.people.filter(p=>!isPersonHidden(p.id)));
  let placed = 0;
  for(const person of visiblePeople){
    const allowance = personGapAllowance(person.id);
    const perInstanceSlots = Math.round(allowance.perInstance/SLOT_MINUTES);
    let totalBudgetSlots = Math.round(allowance.total/SLOT_MINUTES);
    let s = 0;
    while(s < slots.length){
      const occupied = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s));
      const locked = respectLocks && isCellLocked(sched, person.id, s);
      if(occupied || locked){ s++; continue; }

      // Measure this contiguous empty (unlocked) run first — if it's small enough to be
      // an acceptable "hole" (per this person's own allowance, or the remaining slice of
      // their cumulative daily budget), skip past it entirely rather than forcing
      // something into it.
      let gapEnd = s;
      while(gapEnd<slots.length){
        const occ2 = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(gapEnd));
        const lock2 = respectLocks && isCellLocked(sched, person.id, gapEnd);
        if(occ2 || lock2) break;
        gapEnd++;
      }
      const gapLen = gapEnd-s;
      const fitsPerInstance = gapLen <= perInstanceSlots;
      const fitsFromBudget = gapLen <= totalBudgetSlots;
      if(fitsPerInstance || fitsFromBudget){
        if(fitsFromBudget && !fitsPerInstance) totalBudgetSlots -= gapLen; // only spend the cumulative budget when the per-instance allowance alone wasn't enough
        s = gapEnd; continue;
      }

      const options = [];
      for(const pos of state.positions){
        const durChoices = new Set([positionDurationSlots(pos.id), positionMinDurationSlots(pos.id)]);
        for(const durSlots of durChoices){
          if(s+durSlots>slots.length) continue;
          if(respectLocks && range(s, s+durSlots-1).some(sl=>isCellLocked(sched, person.id, sl))) continue;
          const check = isValidPlacement(person.id, pos.id, s, { durSlots });
          if(check.ok){
            const prefScore = preferredMatchesFor(person.id, pos.id, s).length - preferredForbidHits(person.id, pos.id, s, durSlots).length;
            options.push({ positionId: pos.id, durSlots, prefScore });
          }
        }
      }
      if(options.length===0){ s++; continue; }
      const maxScore = Math.max(...options.map(o=>o.prefScore));
      const best = shuffleArray(options.filter(o=>o.prefScore===maxScore));
      const chosen = best[0];
      state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:person.id, positionId:chosen.positionId, startSlot:s, slotCount:chosen.durSlots });
      placed++;
      s += chosen.durSlots;
    }
  }
  return placed;
}

/* After fillAllGaps, some leftover gaps can be smaller than every position's minimum
   duration and so can never be filled by a brand-new assignment. Where the block
   immediately before such a gap has room to grow (its position has a duration range),
   extend it to absorb the gap instead of leaving an unfillable hole. */
function absorbTinyGaps(sched, respectLocks){
  const slots = getSlots();
  let absorbed = 0;
  for(const person of state.people.filter(p=>!isPersonHidden(p.id))){
    const allowance = personGapAllowance(person.id);
    const perInstanceSlots = Math.round(allowance.perInstance/SLOT_MINUTES);
    let totalBudgetSlots = Math.round(allowance.total/SLOT_MINUTES);
    let s = 0;
    while(s < slots.length){
      const occupied = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s));
      const locked = respectLocks && isCellLocked(sched, person.id, s);
      if(occupied || locked){ s++; continue; }
      let gapEnd = s;
      while(gapEnd<slots.length){
        const occ2 = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(gapEnd));
        const lock2 = respectLocks && isCellLocked(sched, person.id, gapEnd);
        if(occ2 || lock2) break;
        gapEnd++;
      }
      const gapLen = gapEnd-s;
      const fitsPerInstance = gapLen <= perInstanceSlots;
      const fitsFromBudget = gapLen <= totalBudgetSlots;
      if(fitsPerInstance || fitsFromBudget){
        if(fitsFromBudget && !fitsPerInstance) totalBudgetSlots -= gapLen;
        s = gapEnd; continue; // acceptable hole — leave it as-is
      }
      const before = state.assignments.find(a=>a.personId===person.id && a.startSlot+a.slotCount===s);
      if(before){
        const newCount = before.slotCount+gapLen;
        if(isValidResize(before.id, newCount).ok){
          resizeAssignment(before.id, newCount);
          absorbed++;
        }
      }
      s = gapEnd;
    }
  }
  return absorbed;
}

function solve(mode){
  mode = mode || 'required';
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  pushUndoSnapshot();

  if(mode==='unlocked' || mode==='all'){
    const before = sched.assignments.length;
    sched.assignments = sched.assignments.filter(a=>{
      if(mode==='all') return false;
      const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
      return occ.some(s=>isCellLocked(sched, a.personId, s));
    });
    state.assignments = sched.assignments;
  }

  const respectLocks = mode==='unlocked';
  const randomize = mode!=='required';

  const MAX_ITER = 4000;
  let iter=0, filled=0;
  while(iter++ < MAX_ITER){
    const pairs = getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage();
    if(pairs.length===0) break;
    let best = null;
    const orderedPairs = randomize ? shuffleArray(pairs) : pairs;
    for(const pair of orderedPairs){
      let cands = candidatesForCoverage(pair.rule, pair.slot, pair.windowEnd);
      if(respectLocks) cands = cands.filter(c=>!range(c.startSlot, c.startSlot+c.durSlots-1).some(s=>isCellLocked(sched, c.personId, s)));
      if(cands.length===0) continue;
      if(!best || cands.length<best.candidates.length) best = { pair, candidates: cands };
    }
    if(!best) break; // everything left is currently unsatisfiable
    let bestCand=null, bestScore=-Infinity;
    const candList = randomize ? shuffleArray(best.candidates) : best.candidates;
    for(const cand of candList){
      const occ = range(cand.startSlot, cand.startSlot+cand.durSlots-1);
      let coverCount=0;
      for(const p of pairs){
        if(occ.includes(p.slot) && personMatchesTarget(p.rule.person, cand.personId) && positionMatchesTarget(p.rule.position, cand.positionId)) coverCount++;
      }
      const prefBonus = preferredMatchesFor(cand.personId, cand.positionId, cand.startSlot).length;
      const prefPenalty = preferredForbidHits(cand.personId, cand.positionId, cand.startSlot, cand.durSlots).length;
      const score = coverCount*10 + prefBonus - prefPenalty*5;
      if(score>bestScore){ bestScore=score; bestCand=cand; }
    }
    state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:bestCand.personId, positionId:bestCand.positionId, startSlot:bestCand.startSlot, slotCount:bestCand.durSlots });
    filled++;
  }

  let prefFilled=0;
  if(mode!=='required'){
    let guard=0, progress=true;
    while(progress && guard++<3000){
      progress=false;
      let suggestions = computeSuggestions();
      if(respectLocks) suggestions = suggestions.filter(s=>!range(s.startSlot, s.startSlot+s.durSlots-1).some(sl=>isCellLocked(sched, s.personId, sl)));
      if(suggestions.length===0) break;
      // Accepting a preferred-require suggestion could still trip a DIFFERENT preferred-forbid
      // rule (e.g. a bilingual-but-female suggestion for a physically-demanding slot). Prefer
      // whichever candidate causes the fewest such conflicts rather than picking blindly.
      const scored = suggestions.map(s=>({ s, penalty: preferredForbidHits(s.personId, s.positionId, s.startSlot, s.durSlots).length }));
      const minPenalty = Math.min(...scored.map(x=>x.penalty));
      const cleanest = scored.filter(x=>x.penalty===minPenalty).map(x=>x.s);
      const sug = randomize ? shuffleArray(cleanest)[0] : cleanest[0];
      state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:sug.personId, positionId:sug.positionId, startSlot:sug.startSlot, slotCount:sug.durSlots });
      prefFilled++; progress=true;
    }
  }

  let gapsFilled = 0, gapsAbsorbed = 0;
  if(mode==='unlocked' || mode==='all'){
    gapsFilled = fillAllGaps(sched, respectLocks);
    gapsAbsorbed = absorbTinyGaps(sched, respectLocks);
  }

  const remaining = getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage().length;
  renderAll();
  const modeLabel = mode==='required' ? 'Fill required' : mode==='unlocked' ? 'Fill unlocked' : 'Fill all';
  let msg = `${modeLabel} — placed ${filled} required assignment${filled===1?'':'s'}`;
  if(mode!=='required') msg += `, ${prefFilled} preferred assignment${prefFilled===1?'':'s'}, and filled ${gapsFilled} more slot${gapsFilled===1?'':'s'}${gapsAbsorbed?` (${gapsAbsorbed} tiny gap${gapsAbsorbed===1?'':'s'} absorbed by widening neighboring blocks)`:''}`;
  msg += '.';
  msg += remaining ? ` ${remaining} required instance${remaining===1?'':'s'} still can't be satisfied — see red items in Decisions.` : ' All required rules satisfied.';
  if(mode==='required') msg += ' Preferred-rule suggestions are shown as stars — click one to accept.';
  showToast(msg);
}

/* ================================================================
   RENDERING
   ================================================================ */
function renderAll(){
  syncDirectRequiredAssignments();
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('db-header-title');
  if(titleEl) titleEl.textContent = `${sched.name} Schedule`;
  document.getElementById('db-header-sub').textContent =
    `${formatTime(state.settings.startMinutes)} – ${formatTime(state.settings.endMinutes)}`;
  const visibleCount = state.people.filter(p=>!isPersonHidden(p.id)).length;
  const rangeNote = document.getElementById('chart-range-note');
  rangeNote.innerHTML = `<span class="range-link" id="range-people-link">${visibleCount} people</span> · <span class="range-link" id="range-positions-link">${state.positions.length} positions</span>`;
  const peopleLink = document.getElementById('range-people-link');
  if(peopleLink) peopleLink.addEventListener('click', ()=>openSettings('people'));
  const positionsLink = document.getElementById('range-positions-link');
  if(positionsLink) positionsLink.addEventListener('click', ()=>openSettings('positions'));
  renderScheduleTabs();
  renderChart();
  renderDecisions();
  renderRules();
  renderHiddenPeopleControl();
  syncRightColumnHeight();
  persist();
}

/* Right column (decisions + settings button) is sized to match the chart's
   natural height, since the chart should never stretch to match a long
   decisions list — the decisions list scrolls internally instead. */
function syncRightColumnHeight(){
  const chartPanel = document.getElementById('chart-panel');
  const decisionsPanel = document.getElementById('decisions-panel');
  const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('btn-settings');
  if(!chartPanel || !decisionsPanel) return;
  const chartH = chartPanel.offsetHeight;
  if(!chartH) return;
  const rightCol = decisionsPanel.parentElement;
  const gap = rightCol ? (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(rightCol).gap) || 14) : 14;
  const settingsH = settingsBtn ? settingsBtn.offsetHeight : 0;
  const decisionsH = Math.max(120, chartH - settingsH - gap);
  decisionsPanel.style.height = decisionsH + 'px';
}

function renderHiddenPeopleControl(){
  const btn = document.getElementById('hidden-people-btn');
  if(!btn) return;
  const hidden = state.people.filter(p=>isPersonHidden(p.id));
  if(hidden.length===0){
    btn.textContent = 'No people toggled off';
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.onclick = null;
    return;
  }
  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.textContent = `${hidden.length} toggled off — select to restore`;
  // A native <select> would show this same "N toggled off" text as a selectable option
  // inside its own open list, which reads like a fake choice — so this uses the same
  // floating-menu pattern as the other toolbar dropdowns instead, where the list holds
  // ONLY the actual "Restore X" actions.
  btn.onclick = (e)=>openHiddenPeopleMenu(e, hidden);
}
function openHiddenPeopleMenu(e, hidden){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const menu = document.createElement('div');
  menu.className = 'db-tab-menu';
  menu.style.width = '200px';
  menu.innerHTML = hidden.map(p=>`<button data-restore-person="${p.id}">Restore ${escapeHtml(p.name)}</button>`).join('');
  layer.appendChild(menu);
  positionFloating(menu, rect);
  menu.querySelectorAll('[data-restore-person]').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      closeFloating();
      togglePersonHidden(b.dataset.restorePerson, false);
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!menu.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function renderScheduleTabs(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('schedule-tabs');
  bar.innerHTML = '';
  state.schedules.forEach((sched, idx)=>{
    const tab = document.createElement('div');
    tab.className = 'db-tab' + (sched.id===state.activeScheduleId ? ' active' : '');
    tab.dataset.scheduleId = sched.id;
    tab.draggable = true;
    tab.title = sched.id===state.activeScheduleId ? 'Click for clone/delete options' : `Switch to ${sched.name}`;
    const cloneMode = state.settings.cloneOriginDisplay || 'right';
    const showCloneOf = !!sched.clonedFromName && cloneMode!=='hidden';
    if(showCloneOf && cloneMode==='under'){
      tab.innerHTML = `<span class="idx">${idx+1}</span><span class="tab-name-stack"><span class="name">${escapeHtml(sched.name)}</span><span class="tab-clone-of under">(clone of ${escapeHtml(sched.clonedFromName)})</span></span>`;
    } else if(showCloneOf){
      tab.innerHTML = `<span class="idx">${idx+1}</span><span class="name">${escapeHtml(sched.name)}</span><span class="tab-clone-of">(clone of ${escapeHtml(sched.clonedFromName)})</span>`;
    } else {
      tab.innerHTML = `<span class="idx">${idx+1}</span><span class="name">${escapeHtml(sched.name)}</span>`;
    }
    tab.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      if(sched.id===state.activeScheduleId) openTabMenu(e, sched.id);
      else setActiveSchedule(sched.id);
    });
    tab.addEventListener('dragstart', ()=>{ tab.classList.add('dragging'); tab.__dragId = sched.id; window.__dbDragScheduleId = sched.id; });
    tab.addEventListener('dragend', ()=>{ tab.classList.remove('dragging'); });
    tab.addEventListener('dragover', (e)=>{ e.preventDefault(); });
    tab.addEventListener('drop', (e)=>{
      e.preventDefault();
      const fromId = window.__dbDragScheduleId;
      if(fromId) reorderSchedule(fromId, sched.id);
    });
    bar.appendChild(tab);
  });
}

function layoutSuggestionStars(starEls){
  const n = starEls.length;
  const set = (el,left,topPct)=>{ el.style.left=left; el.style.top=topPct+'%'; el.style.transform='translateY(-50%)'; };
  if(n===1){ set(starEls[0],'3px',50); }
  else if(n===2){ set(starEls[0],'3px',26); set(starEls[1],'3px',74); }
  else if(n===3){ set(starEls[0],'3px',20); set(starEls[1],'3px',80); set(starEls[2],'15px',50); }
  else{
    const leftCount = Math.ceil(n/2);
    for(let idx=0; idx<n; idx++){
      const col = idx<leftCount ? 0 : 1;
      const rowIdx = col===0 ? idx : idx-leftCount;
      const rowsInCol = col===0 ? leftCount : (n-leftCount);
      const topPct = rowsInCol<=1 ? 50 : (rowIdx/(rowsInCol-1))*70+15;
      set(starEls[idx], (3+col*12)+'px', topPct);
    }
  }
}

function renderChart(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('chart-grid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  const slots = getSlots();
  const visiblePeople = state.people.filter(p=>!isPersonHidden(p.id));
  const sched = activeSchedule();

  const scrollEl = document.querySelector('#chart-panel .db-chart-scroll');
  if(scrollEl) scrollEl.classList.toggle('full-view', fullViewMode);
  grid.classList.toggle('full-view', fullViewMode);
  let colWidth = 32;
  if(fullViewMode && scrollEl){
    const available = scrollEl.clientWidth - rowLabelWidth - 32;
    if(available>0) colWidth = Math.max(3, Math.min(46, Math.floor(available / Math.max(1,slots.length))));
  }
  grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `${rowLabelWidth}px repeat(${slots.length}, ${fullViewMode ? `minmax(${colWidth}px, 1fr)` : `${colWidth}px`})`;
  grid.style.gridTemplateRows = `48px repeat(${visiblePeople.length}, 40px)`;

  const corner = document.createElement('div');
  corner.className = 'db-corner';
  corner.textContent = `${visiblePeople.length} people`;
  grid.appendChild(corner);

  slots.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const showLabel = isHourMark(s,i);
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'db-time-head' + (showLabel ? ' hour-start' : '');
    el.style.gridColumn = `${i+2}`;
    el.style.gridRow = '1';
    el.title = `${s.label} — click for options`;
    el.dataset.slot = i;
    if(showLabel){
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'time-label';
      span.textContent = formatTimeShort(s.minutes);
      el.appendChild(span);
    }
    if(sched.lockedSlots.has(i)){
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'db-lock-badge';
      badge.textContent = '🔒';
      el.appendChild(badge);
    }
    el.addEventListener('click', (e)=>openTimeHeadPopup(e, i));
    grid.appendChild(el);
  });

  visiblePeople.forEach((p,pi)=>{
    const label = document.createElement('div');
    label.className = 'db-row-label';
    label.style.gridColumn = '1';
    label.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
    label.dataset.personId = p.id;
    const lockBadge = sched.lockedPeople.has(p.id) ? '<span class="db-lock-badge">🔒</span>' : '';
    label.innerHTML = `${lockBadge}<div class="name">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div><div class="tags${showPersonTags?'':' tags-hidden'}">${p.tags.map(t=>tagChipHtml(t)).join('')}</div>`;
    label.addEventListener('click', (e)=>openPersonPopup(e, p.id));
    grid.appendChild(label);

    slots.forEach((s,si)=>{
      const cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'db-cell' + (isHourMark(s,si) ? ' hour-start' : '');
      cell.style.gridColumn = `${si+2}`;
      cell.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
      cell.dataset.person = p.id;
      cell.dataset.slot = si;
      cell.title = `${p.name} · ${s.label} — click to assign`;
      const hasAssignmentHere = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===p.id && a.startSlot===si);
      if(!hasAssignmentHere && sched.lockedCells.has(cellKeyFor(p.id, si)) && !sched.lockedPeople.has(p.id) && !sched.lockedSlots.has(si)){
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'db-lock-badge';
        badge.textContent = '🔒';
        cell.appendChild(badge);
      }
      cell.addEventListener('click', (e)=>onCellClick(e, p.id, si));
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    });
  });

  // Resize handle for the name column, spans the full header+body height.
  const rowResizeHandle = document.createElement('div');
  rowResizeHandle.className = 'db-row-resize-handle';
  rowResizeHandle.style.gridRow = `1 / span ${visiblePeople.length+1}`;
  rowResizeHandle.title = 'Drag to resize the name column';
  rowResizeHandle.addEventListener('mousedown', startRowLabelResize);
  grid.appendChild(rowResizeHandle);

  const violations = computeViolations();

  state.assignments.forEach(a=>{
    const pi = visiblePeople.findIndex(p=>p.id===a.personId);
    if(pi<0) return;
    const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===a.positionId);
    if(!pos) return;
    const block = document.createElement('div');
    block.className = 'db-block confirmed';
    const isViolated = violations.some(v=>v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled' && v.assignment.id===a.id);
    if(isViolated) block.classList.add('rule-violated');
    block.style.gridColumn = `${a.startSlot+2} / span ${a.slotCount}`;
    block.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
    block.style.background = pos.color;
    block.style.color = pos.textColor || '#FFFFFF';
    block.textContent = (pos.display && pos.display.trim()) ? pos.display : pos.name;
    block.dataset.assignmentId = a.id;
    block.title = `${pos.name} · ${personName(a.personId)} · click to remove`;
    block.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); openAssignmentPopup(e, a); });
    if(pos.durationMin!==pos.durationMax){
      const handle = document.createElement('div');
      handle.className = 'resize-handle';
      handle.title = `Drag to resize (${pos.durationMin}-${pos.durationMax} min)`;
      handle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e)=>startResizeDrag(e, a.id));
      block.appendChild(handle);
    }
    if(sched.lockedCells.has(cellKeyFor(a.personId, a.startSlot)) && !sched.lockedPeople.has(a.personId) && !sched.lockedSlots.has(a.startSlot)){
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'db-lock-badge';
      badge.textContent = '🔒';
      block.appendChild(badge);
    }
    grid.appendChild(block);
  });

  const suggestions = computeSuggestions();
  const grouped = new Map();
  suggestions.forEach(sug=>{
    const key = `${sug.personId}|${sug.startSlot}`;
    if(!grouped.has(key)) grouped.set(key, []);
    grouped.get(key).push(sug);
  });
  grouped.forEach((group, key)=>{
    const [personId, startSlotStr] = key.split('|');
    const startSlot = Number(startSlotStr);
    const pi = visiblePeople.findIndex(p=>p.id===personId);
    if(pi<0) return;
    const maxDur = Math.max(...group.map(g=>g.durSlots));
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'db-suggestion-box';
    box.style.gridColumn = `${startSlot+2} / span ${maxDur}`;
    box.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
    box.title = `${group.length} suggestion${group.length===1?'':'s'} — click a star to accept or reject, or click elsewhere in the cell to assign as usual`;
    box.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      // Star clicks call stopPropagation() themselves, so this only fires for clicks
      // elsewhere in the box — letting the person assign a slot as if it were empty,
      // exactly like clicking any other unfilled cell would.
      const rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      const perSlotWidth = rect.width / maxDur;
      const offsetSlots = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxDur-1, Math.floor((e.clientX-rect.left)/perSlotWidth)));
      onCellClick(e, personId, startSlot+offsetSlots);
    });
    const starEls = [];
    group.forEach(sug=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===sug.positionId);
      if(!pos) return;
      const star = document.createElement('span');
      star.className = 'db-suggestion-star';
      star.style.color = pos.color;
      star.textContent = '★';
      star.title = `${pos.name} for ${personName(personId)}`;
      star.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); openSuggestionPopup(e, sug); });
      box.appendChild(star);
      starEls.push(star);
    });
    layoutSuggestionStars(starEls);
    grid.appendChild(box);
  });
}

/* ---------------- Drag-to-resize a position's in-schedule duration ---------------- */
function startResizeDrag(e, assignmentId){
  e.stopPropagation();
  e.preventDefault();
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===assignmentId);
  if(!a) return;
  const block = document.querySelector(`.db-block[data-assignment-id="${assignmentId}"]`);
  const rect = block ? block.getBoundingClientRect() : { width: 32*a.slotCount };
  const perSlotWidth = (rect.width || 32*a.slotCount) / a.slotCount;
  resizeDrag = { assignmentId, startX: e.clientX, startSlotCount: a.slotCount, perSlotWidth: perSlotWidth||32, lastValidSlotCount: a.slotCount };
  if(block) block.classList.add('resizing');
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', onResizeMouseUp);
}
function onResizeMouseMove(e){
  if(!resizeDrag) return;
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===resizeDrag.assignmentId);
  if(!a) return;
  const deltaPx = e.clientX - resizeDrag.startX;
  const deltaSlots = Math.round(deltaPx / resizeDrag.perSlotWidth);
  const minSlots = positionMinDurationSlots(a.positionId);
  const maxSlots = positionMaxDurationSlots(a.positionId);
  let candidate = Math.max(minSlots, Math.min(maxSlots, resizeDrag.startSlotCount + deltaSlots));
  const check = isValidResize(resizeDrag.assignmentId, candidate);
  if(check.ok){
    resizeDrag.lastValidSlotCount = candidate;
    const block = document.querySelector(`.db-block[data-assignment-id="${resizeDrag.assignmentId}"]`);
    if(block) block.style.gridColumn = `${a.startSlot+2} / span ${candidate}`;
  }
}
function onResizeMouseUp(){
  if(!resizeDrag) return;
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===resizeDrag.assignmentId);
  const finalCount = resizeDrag.lastValidSlotCount;
  document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMouseMove);
  document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onResizeMouseUp);
  resizeDrag = null;
  if(a && finalCount!==a.slotCount){
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    applyResizeWithDisplacement(a.id, finalCount);
  }
  renderAll();
}

/* ---------------- Drag-to-resize the name column width ---------------- */
function startRowLabelResize(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  rowLabelResizeDrag = { startX: e.clientX, startWidth: rowLabelWidth };
  const handle = e.currentTarget;
  if(handle) handle.classList.add('dragging');
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', onRowLabelResizeMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', onRowLabelResizeUp);
}
function onRowLabelResizeMove(e){
  if(!rowLabelResizeDrag) return;
  const delta = e.clientX - rowLabelResizeDrag.startX;
  rowLabelWidth = Math.max(90, Math.min(320, rowLabelResizeDrag.startWidth + delta));
  const grid = document.getElementById('chart-grid');
  if(grid && grid.style.gridTemplateColumns){
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = grid.style.gridTemplateColumns.replace(/^[\d.]+px/, `${rowLabelWidth}px`);
  }
}
function onRowLabelResizeUp(){
  document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onRowLabelResizeMove);
  document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onRowLabelResizeUp);
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-row-resize-handle.dragging').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('dragging'));
  rowLabelResizeDrag = null;
  renderChart();
}

function ruleNicknamePrefix(rule){
  return rule.nickname ? `<strong>${escapeHtml(rule.nickname)}</strong> — ` : '';
}

function renderDecisions(){
  const body = document.getElementById('decisions-body');
  body.innerHTML = '';
  const violations = computeViolations();

  violations.forEach(v=>{
    const isPreferredViolation = v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled' && v.rule.strength==='preferred';
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'db-violation-card' + (isPreferredViolation ? ' preferred' : '');
    const tag = document.createElement('span');
    tag.className = 'tag';
    tag.textContent = v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled' ? (isPreferredViolation ? 'Preferred Rule Violated' : 'Required Rule Violated')
      : v.kind==='overcapacity' ? 'Required — over capacity' : 'Required — unfilled';
    const txt = document.createElement('div');
    txt.className = 'txt';
    if(v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled'){
      txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(v.rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(v.rule))} But ${escapeHtml(personName(v.assignment.personId))} is scheduled for ${escapeHtml(positionName(v.assignment.positionId))} at ${getSlots()[v.assignment.startSlot].label}.`;
    } else if(v.kind==='overcapacity'){
      txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(v.rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(v.rule))} Too many people at ${getSlots()[v.slot].label}.`;
    } else {
      txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(v.rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(v.rule))} Not yet covered at ${getSlots()[v.slot].label}.`;
    }
    card.appendChild(tag); card.appendChild(txt);
    card.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if(v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled') flashCell(v.assignment.personId, v.assignment.startSlot);
      else flashCell(null, v.slot);
    });
    body.appendChild(card);
  });

  const pairs = getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage();
  const decisionItems = pairs
    .map(pair=>({ pair, count: candidatesForCoverage(pair.rule, pair.slot, pair.windowEnd).length }))
    .sort((a,b)=>a.count-b.count)
    .slice(0,20);

  decisionItems.forEach(item=>{
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'db-decision-card';
    const top = document.createElement('div'); top.className = 'top-row';
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'count-badge' + (item.count===0 ? ' zero' : '');
    badge.textContent = item.count===0 ? '0 options' : `${item.count} option${item.count===1?'':'s'}`;
    top.appendChild(badge);
    card.appendChild(top);
    const txt = document.createElement('div'); txt.className = 'txt';
    txt.textContent = `${ruleLabel(item.pair.rule)} Needs coverage at ${getSlots()[item.pair.slot].label}.`;
    card.appendChild(txt);
    card.addEventListener('click', ()=>flashCell(null, item.pair.slot));
    body.appendChild(card);
  });

  const hotSpots = computeHotSpots();
  if(hotSpots.length){
    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'db-rules-section-title';
    title.textContent = 'Big decisions';
    body.appendChild(title);
    hotSpots.forEach(hs=>{
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'db-decision-card hotspot';
      const top = document.createElement('div'); top.className = 'top-row';
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'count-badge';
      badge.style.background = 'var(--impact)';
      badge.textContent = `impact ${hs.impact}`;
      top.appendChild(badge);
      card.appendChild(top);
      const txt = document.createElement('div'); txt.className = 'txt';
      txt.textContent = `${personName(hs.personId)} @ ${getSlots()[hs.slot].label}`;
      card.appendChild(txt);
      card.addEventListener('click', ()=>flashCell(hs.personId, hs.slot));
      body.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  if(pairs.length===0 && violations.length===0 && hotSpots.length===0){
    const empty = document.createElement('div');
    empty.className = 'db-empty-note';
    empty.textContent = 'No open required decisions — all required coverage is satisfied.';
    body.appendChild(empty);
  }

  document.getElementById('decisions-note').textContent = `${violations.length} violated · ${pairs.length} open`;
}

function flashCell(personId, slotIndex){
  clearAllHighlights();
  let targets;
  if(personId) targets = document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-person="${personId}"][data-slot="${slotIndex}"]`);
  else targets = document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-slot="${slotIndex}"]`);
  targets.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('cell-flash'));
  if(targets[0]) targets[0].scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'nearest', inline:'center' });
  setTimeout(()=>{ targets.forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('cell-flash')); }, 1600);
}

/* ---------------- Rules list ---------------- */
function matchesDimFilter(target, filterVal){
  if(filterVal==='all') return true;
  if(!target) return false; // this rule kind doesn't have this dimension at all (e.g. an unfilled-time allowance has no position/time)
  const isAnyRestricted = target.mode==='any' && (((target.requiredTags||[]).length) || ((target.prohibitedTags||[]).length));
  if(filterVal==='unused') return target.mode==='any' && !isAnyRestricted;
  if(filterVal==='general') return target.mode==='tag' || target.mode==='range' || isAnyRestricted;
  if(filterVal==='specific') return target.mode==='id';
  return true;
}
function getFilteredRules(){
  const search = document.getElementById('rule-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const fPerson = document.getElementById('filter-person').value;
  const fPosition = document.getElementById('filter-position').value;
  const fTime = document.getElementById('filter-time').value;
  const fRuleTag = document.getElementById('filter-rule-tag').value;
  const showRequired = document.getElementById('filter-required').checked;
  const showPreferred = document.getElementById('filter-preferred').checked;
  const showInactive = document.getElementById('filter-inactive').checked;

  return state.rules.filter(rule=>{
    if(rule.strength==='required' && !showRequired) return false;
    if(rule.strength==='preferred' && !showPreferred) return false;
    if(!rule.active && !showInactive) return false;
    if(!matchesDimFilter(rule.person, fPerson)) return false;
    if(!matchesDimFilter(rule.position, fPosition)) return false;
    if(!matchesDimFilter(rule.slot, fTime)) return false;
    if(fRuleTag!=='all' && !(rule.tags||[]).includes(fRuleTag)) return false;
    if(rulesFocusPersonId){
      const touchesFocus = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, rulesFocusPersonId) ||
        (rule.kind==='relative' && rule.relative && rule.relative.otherPerson && personMatchesTarget(rule.relative.otherPerson, rulesFocusPersonId));
      if(!touchesFocus) return false;
    }
    if(rulesFocusSlotIndex!==null){
      if(!slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, rulesFocusSlotIndex)) return false;
    }
    if(search){
      const tagText = (rule.tags||[]).map(tid=>tagName(tid)).join(' ');
      const hay = (rule.nickname||'') + ' ' + ruleLabel(rule) + ' ' + tagText;
      if(!hay.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
}
function renderRules(){
  const body = document.getElementById('rules-body');
  body.innerHTML = '';

  const ruleTagSel = document.getElementById('filter-rule-tag');
  if(ruleTagSel){
    const currentVal = ruleTagSel.value;
    const ruleTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='rule');
    ruleTagSel.innerHTML = `<option value="all">All tags</option>` + ruleTags.map(t=>`<option value="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</option>`).join('');
    if(ruleTags.some(t=>t.id===currentVal)) ruleTagSel.value = currentVal;
  }

  if(rulesFocusPersonId || rulesFocusSlotIndex!==null){
    const chip = document.createElement('div');
    chip.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:10px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;';
    const label = rulesFocusPersonId
      ? `Showing rules for <strong style="color:var(--ink);">${escapeHtml(personName(rulesFocusPersonId))}</strong>`
      : `Showing rules touching <strong style="color:var(--ink);">${getSlots()[rulesFocusSlotIndex].label}</strong>`;
    chip.innerHTML = label;
    const clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
    clearBtn.className = 'btn btn-sm';
    clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear';
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ rulesFocusPersonId = null; rulesFocusSlotIndex = null; renderRules(); });
    chip.appendChild(clearBtn);
    body.appendChild(chip);
  }

  const filtered = getFilteredRules();
  const violations = computeViolations();
  const required = filtered.filter(r=>r.strength==='required');
  const preferred = filtered.filter(r=>r.strength==='preferred');

  const section = (title, rules)=>{
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'db-rules-section-title';
    h.textContent = `${title} (${rules.length})`;
    body.appendChild(h);
    if(rules.length===0){
      const e = document.createElement('div');
      e.className = 'db-empty-note';
      e.textContent = 'No rules match the current filters.';
      body.appendChild(e);
      return;
    }
    rules.forEach(rule=>body.appendChild(renderRuleRow(rule, violations)));
  };
  section('Required rules', required);
  section('Preferred rules', preferred);

  document.getElementById('rules-count-note').textContent = `${filtered.length} / ${state.rules.length} shown`;
}
function renderRuleRow(rule, violations){
  const isViolated = violations.some(v=>v.rule.id===rule.id);
  const row = document.createElement('div');
  row.className = 'db-rule-row' + (isViolated ? ' violated' : '') + (!rule.active ? ' inactive' : '');

  const chip = document.createElement('span');
  chip.className = 'effect-chip ' + rule.effect;
  chip.textContent = rule.effect==='forbid' ? 'FORBID' : 'REQUIRE';
  row.appendChild(chip);

  if(rule.kind==='relative'){
    const relChip = document.createElement('span');
    relChip.className = 'effect-chip';
    relChip.style.background = '#EDE9FE'; relChip.style.color = '#5B21B6';
    relChip.textContent = 'RELATIVE';
    row.appendChild(relChip);
  }
  if(rule.kind==='unfilledAllowance'){
    const allowChip = document.createElement('span');
    allowChip.className = 'effect-chip';
    allowChip.style.background = '#DCFCE7'; allowChip.style.color = '#166534';
    allowChip.textContent = 'ALLOWANCE';
    row.appendChild(allowChip);
  }

  const main = document.createElement('div'); main.className = 'rule-main';
  const txt = document.createElement('div'); txt.className = 'rule-text';
  txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(rule))}`;
  if(isViolated){
    // Appended to the description text itself (not the tag/meta line below) so it
    // doesn't read ambiguously as if it were just another tag pill.
    const isPreferredViol = rule.strength==='preferred';
    const color = isPreferredViol ? 'var(--pref-violation)' : 'var(--danger)';
    const label = isPreferredViol ? 'Preferred rule violated.' : 'Required rule violated.';
    txt.innerHTML += ` <span class="db-inline-violation" style="color:${color};font-weight:700;">${label}</span>`;
  }
  main.appendChild(txt);
  const meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className = 'rule-meta';
  (rule.tags||[]).forEach(tid=>{
    const html = tagChipHtml(tid);
    if(html){
      const wrap = document.createElement('span');
      wrap.innerHTML = html;
      meta.appendChild(wrap.firstChild);
    }
  });
  main.appendChild(meta);
  row.appendChild(main);

  const actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'rule-actions';
  const sw = document.createElement('label');
  sw.className = 'db-switch';
  sw.title = rule.active ? 'Active (click to deactivate)' : 'Inactive (click to activate)';
  sw.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" ${rule.active?'checked':''}/><span class="track"></span><span class="thumb"></span>`;
  sw.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ rule.active = e.target.checked; renderAll(); });
  actions.appendChild(sw);

  const editBtn = document.createElement('button');
  editBtn.className = 'db-icon-btn'; editBtn.textContent = '✎'; editBtn.title = 'Edit rule';
  editBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>openSettings('rules', rule.id));
  actions.appendChild(editBtn);

  const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
  delBtn.className = 'db-icon-btn'; delBtn.textContent = '🗑'; delBtn.title = 'Delete rule';
  delBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(confirm('Delete this rule? This cannot be undone.')){
      state.rules = state.rules.filter(r=>r.id!==rule.id);
      renderAll();
    }
  });
  actions.appendChild(delBtn);

  row.appendChild(actions);
  return row;
}

/* ================================================================
   FLOATING UI: dropdown, popups, tab menu
   ================================================================ */
let currentCloser = null;
/* Popups are normally appended to #floating-layer, but the Fullscreen API only
   renders descendants of whichever element is currently fullscreen — content
   outside it (like the default #floating-layer, a sibling of #chart-panel) goes
   invisible. So while something is fullscreen, popups get a layer created inside
   that same fullscreen element instead. */
function getFloatingLayer(){
  const fsEl = document.fullscreenElement;
  if(fsEl){
    let layer = fsEl.querySelector(':scope > #floating-layer-fs');
    if(!layer){
      layer = document.createElement('div');
      layer.id = 'floating-layer-fs';
      fsEl.appendChild(layer);
    }
    return layer;
  }
  return document.getElementById('floating-layer');
}
function registerCloser(fn){
  if(currentCloser) document.removeEventListener('mousedown', currentCloser);
  currentCloser = fn;
  setTimeout(()=>document.addEventListener('mousedown', currentCloser), 0);
}
function closeFloating(){
  const defaultLayer = document.getElementById('floating-layer');
  if(defaultLayer) defaultLayer.innerHTML = '';
  const fsLayer = document.getElementById('floating-layer-fs');
  if(fsLayer) fsLayer.innerHTML = '';
  if(currentCloser){ document.removeEventListener('mousedown', currentCloser); currentCloser = null; }
}
function positionFloating(el, rect){
  const margin = 8;
  const w = el.offsetWidth || 260, h = el.offsetHeight || 120;
  let left = rect.left, top = rect.bottom + margin;
  if(left+w > window.innerWidth-margin) left = window.innerWidth-margin-w;
  if(top+h > window.innerHeight-margin) top = rect.top-h-margin;
  if(left<margin) left = margin;
  if(top<margin) top = margin;
  el.style.left = `${left}px`;
  el.style.top = `${top}px`;
}
function clearAllHighlights(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.cell-flash, .highlight-red').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('cell-flash','highlight-red'));
}
function applyOptionHighlight(opt, personId, slotIndex){
  clearAllHighlights();
  if(opt.conflictAssignmentId){
    const block = document.querySelector(`[data-assignment-id="${opt.conflictAssignmentId}"]`);
    if(block) block.classList.add('cell-flash');
    range(slotIndex, slotIndex+opt.durSlots-1).forEach(c=>{
      document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-person="${personId}"][data-slot="${c}"]`).forEach(el=>el.classList.add('cell-flash'));
    });
    return;
  }
  const h = opt.highlights;
  if(!h) return;
  h.personIds.forEach(pid=>{
    const row = document.querySelector(`.db-row-label[data-person-id="${pid}"]`);
    if(row) row.classList.add('highlight-red');
  });
  h.slots.forEach(s=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-person="${personId}"][data-slot="${s}"]`).forEach(el=>el.classList.add('cell-flash'));
  });
  h.assignmentIds.forEach(aid=>{
    const block = document.querySelector(`[data-assignment-id="${aid}"]`);
    if(block) block.classList.add('cell-flash');
  });
  h.scheduleIds.forEach(sid=>{
    const tab = document.querySelector(`.db-tab[data-schedule-id="${sid}"]`);
    if(tab) tab.classList.add('highlight-red');
  });
}

function positionOptionsFor(personId, slotIndex){
  return state.positions.map(pos=>{
    const check = isValidPlacement(personId, pos.id, slotIndex);
    const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(pos.id);
    const prefMatches = check.ok ? preferredMatchesFor(personId, pos.id, slotIndex) : [];
    const history = historicalRatio(personId, pos.id, slotIndex);
    return { position:pos, ok:check.ok, reason:check.reason, conflictAssignmentId:check.conflictAssignmentId, highlights:check.highlights, starred: prefMatches.length>0, durSlots, history };
  });
}

function onCellClick(e, personId, slotIndex){
  closeFloating();
  openAssignDropdown(e, personId, slotIndex);
}

function findLockBadgeEl(kind, key){
  if(kind==='person') return document.querySelector(`.db-row-label[data-person-id="${key}"] .db-lock-badge`);
  if(kind==='slot') return document.querySelector(`.db-time-head[data-slot="${key}"] .db-lock-badge`);
  if(kind==='cell'){
    const [pid,slotStr] = String(key).split('|');
    const slot = Number(slotStr);
    const cellBadge = document.querySelector(`.db-cell[data-person="${pid}"][data-slot="${slot}"] .db-lock-badge`);
    if(cellBadge) return cellBadge;
    // When the locked slot is filled, renderChart() puts the badge on the assignment
    // BLOCK instead of the (now-covered) empty cell underneath it — look there too,
    // or a newly-locked position entry would never visibly flash.
    const covering = state.assignments.find(a=>a.personId===pid && slot>=a.startSlot && slot<a.startSlot+a.slotCount);
    if(covering) return document.querySelector(`.db-block[data-assignment-id="${covering.id}"] .db-lock-badge`);
    return null;
  }
  return null;
}
function flashLockIcon(kind, key){
  if(lockDisplayMode) return;
  const el = findLockBadgeEl(kind, key);
  if(!el) return;
  el.classList.remove('flash-show');
  void el.offsetWidth; // force reflow so a repeated flash restarts the animation
  el.classList.add('flash-show');
  setTimeout(()=>{ el.classList.remove('flash-show'); }, 2700);
}
function showSingleLockIcon(kind, key){
  hideLockIcons();
  const el = findLockBadgeEl(kind, key);
  if(el) el.classList.add('force-show');
}
function hideLockIcons(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-lock-badge.force-show').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('force-show'));
}

function openAssignDropdown(e, personId, slotIndex){
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dd = document.createElement('div');
  dd.className = 'db-dropdown';
  const options = positionOptionsFor(personId, slotIndex);
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  const cellKey = cellKeyFor(personId, slotIndex);
  const cellLocked = sched.lockedCells.has(cellKey);
  const pasteBtnHtml = positionClipboard
    ? `<button class="db-option-lock-toggle" id="dd-paste" title="Paste ${escapeHtml(positionName(positionClipboard.positionId))} here">📋</button>` : '';
  dd.innerHTML = `<div class="db-dropdown-head db-option-head-actions">
      <span>${escapeHtml(personName(personId))} · ${getSlots()[slotIndex].label}</span>
      <span style="display:flex;gap:4px;">${pasteBtnHtml}<button class="db-option-lock-toggle ${cellLocked?'on':''}" id="dd-lock-cell" title="${cellLocked?'Unlock this cell':'Lock this cell'}">🔒</button></span>
    </div><div class="db-dropdown-list"></div>`;
  const pasteBtn = dd.querySelector('#dd-paste');
  if(pasteBtn){
    pasteBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      closeFloating();
      pastePositionAt(personId, slotIndex);
    });
  }
  const lockCellBtn = dd.querySelector('#dd-lock-cell');
  lockCellBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    const wasLocked = sched.lockedCells.has(cellKey);
    if(wasLocked) sched.lockedCells.delete(cellKey);
    else sched.lockedCells.add(cellKey);
    closeFloating();
    renderAll();
    if(!wasLocked) flashLockIcon('cell', cellKey);
  });
  lockCellBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>showSingleLockIcon('cell', cellKey));
  lockCellBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideLockIcons);
  const list = dd.querySelector('.db-dropdown-list');
  options.forEach(opt=>{
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'db-option ' + (opt.ok ? 'ok' : 'blocked');
    const durMinSafe = opt.position.durationMin!==undefined ? opt.position.durationMin : SLOT_MINUTES;
    const durMaxSafe = opt.position.durationMax!==undefined ? opt.position.durationMax : durMinSafe;
    const durText = durMinSafe===durMaxSafe ? `${durMinSafe}m` : `${durMinSafe}-${durMaxSafe}m`;
    const historyText = opt.history ? `<span class="history-ratio">${opt.history.matches}/${opt.history.total} previous</span>` : '';
    row.innerHTML = `<span class="dot" style="background:${opt.position.color}"></span>
      <span class="label">${escapeHtml(opt.position.name)}${opt.starred?' <span class="star-mark">★</span>':''}</span>
      ${historyText}
      <span class="dur">${durText}</span>`;
    if(opt.ok){
      row.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        pushUndoSnapshot();
        state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId, positionId:opt.position.id, startSlot:slotIndex, slotCount:opt.durSlots });
        closeFloating();
        renderAll();
      });
    } else {
      row.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>{
        const tip = document.createElement('div');
        tip.className = 'db-option-tooltip';
        tip.textContent = opt.reason;
        row.appendChild(tip);
        applyOptionHighlight(opt, personId, slotIndex);
      });
      row.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>{
        const tip = row.querySelector('.db-option-tooltip');
        if(tip) tip.remove();
        clearAllHighlights();
      });
    }
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
  layer.appendChild(dd);
  positionFloating(dd, rect);
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!dd.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function openSuggestionPopup(e, sug){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
  const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===sug.positionId);
  const rules = sug.ruleIds.map(id=>state.rules.find(r=>r.id===id)).filter(Boolean);
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">Suggested: ${escapeHtml(pos ? pos.name : '?')}</div>
    <div class="rule-hint">${rules.map(r=>escapeHtml(ruleLabel(r))).join('<br>')}</div>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-reject">Reject</button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="pop-accept">Accept</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  pop.querySelector('#pop-accept').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:sug.personId, positionId:sug.positionId, startSlot:sug.startSlot, slotCount:sug.durSlots });
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-reject').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    state.rejectedSuggestions.add(sug.key);
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function openAssignmentPopup(e, a){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
  const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===a.positionId);
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  const cellKey = cellKeyFor(a.personId, a.startSlot);
  const locked = sched.lockedCells.has(cellKey);
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">${escapeHtml(pos ? pos.name : '?')} — ${escapeHtml(personName(a.personId))}</div>
    <div class="rule-hint">${getSlots()[a.startSlot].label} · ${a.slotCount*SLOT_MINUTES} min</div>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-cut">Cut</button><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-copy">Copy</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-lock">${locked?'🔓 Unlock cell':'🔒 Lock cell'}</button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger-outline" id="pop-remove">Remove</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  pop.querySelector('#pop-cut').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    cutAssignment(a.id);
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-copy').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    copyAssignment(a.id);
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-remove').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    state.assignments = state.assignments.filter(x=>x.id!==a.id);
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  const lockBtn = pop.querySelector('#pop-lock');
  lockBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    const wasLocked = sched.lockedCells.has(cellKey);
    if(wasLocked) sched.lockedCells.delete(cellKey);
    else sched.lockedCells.add(cellKey);
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
    if(!wasLocked) flashLockIcon('cell', cellKey);
  });
  lockBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>showSingleLockIcon('cell', cellKey));
  lockBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideLockIcons);
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function openPersonPopup(e, personId){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
  const person = state.people.find(p=>p.id===personId);
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  const locked = sched.lockedPeople.has(personId);
  const tagsHtml = person.tags.map(t=>tagChipHtml(t)).join(' ') || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">No tags</span>';
  const namesArmed = pendingSwap && pendingSwap.mode==='names';
  const rowsArmed = pendingSwap && pendingSwap.mode==='rows';
  const namesLabel = namesArmed ? `🔄 Swap names: ${escapeHtml(personName(pendingSwap.personId))}` : '🔄 Swap names';
  const rowsLabel = rowsArmed ? `🔄 Swap rows: ${escapeHtml(personName(pendingSwap.personId))}` : '🔄 Swap rows';
  const pasteRowBtnHtml = rowClipboard ? `<div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-paste-row" style="width:100%;">📋 Paste row</button></div>` : '';
  pop.innerHTML = `<button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-see-person" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:8px;">See ${escapeHtml(person.name)}</button>
    <div class="rule-hint">${tagsHtml}</div>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm db-popup-half-btn" id="pop-lock-person">${locked?'🔓 Unlock row':'🔒 Lock row'}</button><button class="btn btn-sm db-popup-half-btn" id="pop-toggle-person">🔘 Toggle person</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm db-popup-half-btn ${namesArmed?'armed':''}" id="pop-swap-names">${namesLabel}</button><button class="btn btn-sm db-popup-half-btn ${rowsArmed?'armed':''}" id="pop-swap-rows">${rowsLabel}</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm db-popup-half-btn" id="pop-copy-row">📋 Copy row</button><button class="btn btn-sm db-popup-half-btn btn-danger-outline" id="pop-clear-row">🗑 Clear row</button></div>
    ${pasteRowBtnHtml}
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="pop-show-rules" style="width:100%;">▦ Show rules</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  pop.querySelector('#pop-see-person').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    openSettings('people');
    const row = document.querySelector(`#people-tbody tr[data-person-row="${personId}"]`);
    if(row){
      row.classList.remove('db-row-flash-target');
      void row.offsetWidth; // restart the animation even if it was just played
      row.classList.add('db-row-flash-target');
      if(row.scrollIntoView) row.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' });
    }
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-show-rules').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    rulesFocusPersonId = personId;
    closeFloating();
    renderRules();
    const panel = document.getElementById('rules-panel');
    if(panel.scrollIntoView) panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
  });
  const lockPersonBtn = pop.querySelector('#pop-lock-person');
  lockPersonBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    const wasLocked = sched.lockedPeople.has(personId);
    if(wasLocked) sched.lockedPeople.delete(personId);
    else sched.lockedPeople.add(personId);
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
    if(!wasLocked) flashLockIcon('person', personId);
  });
  lockPersonBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>showSingleLockIcon('person', personId));
  lockPersonBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideLockIcons);
  pop.querySelector('#pop-toggle-person').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    togglePersonHidden(personId, true);
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-swap-names').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(namesArmed){
      if(pendingSwap.personId!==personId){ pushUndoSnapshot(); swapPersonNames(pendingSwap.personId, personId); }
      pendingSwap = null;
    } else {
      pendingSwap = { mode:'names', personId };
    }
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-swap-rows').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(rowsArmed){
      if(pendingSwap.personId!==personId){ pushUndoSnapshot(); swapPersonRows(pendingSwap.personId, personId); }
      pendingSwap = null;
    } else {
      pendingSwap = { mode:'rows', personId };
    }
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-copy-row').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    copyPersonRow(personId);
  });
  const pasteRowBtn = pop.querySelector('#pop-paste-row');
  if(pasteRowBtn){
    pasteRowBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      closeFloating();
      pastePersonRow(personId);
    });
  }
  pop.querySelector('#pop-clear-row').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    clearPersonRow(personId);
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function openTimeHeadPopup(e, slotIndex){
  closeFloating();

  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
