  // "wipe the whole column", so these are small purpose-drawn SVGs instead.
  const clearTimeIcon = `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" style="vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:5px;"><rect x="1" y="6" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="6.5" y="6" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="1.4 1.4"/><rect x="11" y="6" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/></svg>`;
  const clearAllIcon = `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" style="vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:5px;"><rect x="3" y="2" width="10" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/><line x1="4" y1="3" x2="12" y2="13" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/><line x1="12" y1="3" x2="4" y2="13" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/></svg>`;
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">${getSlots()[slotIndex].label}</div>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-lock-time" style="width:100%;">${locked?'🔓 Unlock column':'🔒 Lock column'}</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger-outline" id="pop-clear-time" style="width:100%;" title="Trims just this slot out of any assignment crossing it, keeping the remainder(s).">${clearTimeIcon}Clear this time</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger-outline" id="pop-clear-assignments" style="width:100%;" title="Removes every assignment that overlaps this column, in its entirety.">${clearAllIcon}Clear assignments</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="pop-show-time-rules" style="width:100%;">▦ Show rules for this time</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  const lockTimeBtn = pop.querySelector('#pop-lock-time');
  lockTimeBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pushUndoSnapshot();
    const wasLocked = sched.lockedSlots.has(slotIndex);
    if(wasLocked) sched.lockedSlots.delete(slotIndex);
    else sched.lockedSlots.add(slotIndex);
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
    if(!wasLocked) flashLockIcon('slot', slotIndex);
  });
  lockTimeBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>showSingleLockIcon('slot', slotIndex));
  lockTimeBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideLockIcons);
  pop.querySelector('#pop-clear-time').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    clearTimeColumn(slotIndex, 'split');
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-clear-assignments').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    clearTimeColumn(slotIndex, 'whole');
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-show-time-rules').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    rulesFocusSlotIndex = slotIndex;
    closeFloating();
    renderRules();
    const panel = document.getElementById('rules-panel');
    if(panel.scrollIntoView) panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function swapPersonNames(idA, idB){
  const a = state.people.find(p=>p.id===idA), b = state.people.find(p=>p.id===idB);
  if(!a || !b) return;
  const tmp = a.name; a.name = b.name; b.name = tmp;
}
function swapPersonRows(idA, idB){
  state.assignments.forEach(asg=>{
    if(asg.personId===idA) asg.personId = idB;
    else if(asg.personId===idB) asg.personId = idA;
  });
}

/* ---------------- Clear operations (row / time column) ---------------- */
/* Clears every NON-locked assignment for a person, in its entirety. Locked
   assignments (checked at their own start slot) are left untouched. */
function clearPersonRow(personId){
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  pushUndoSnapshot();
  const kept = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId!==personId || isCellLocked(sched, personId, a.startSlot));
  sched.assignments = kept;
  state.assignments = kept;
  renderAll();
}

/* Clears a single time column. mode='split' trims just that slot out of any assignment
   crossing it, leaving the remainder(s) intact as their own assignment(s) — clearing the
   last slot of a 15-min block leaves a 10-min block; clearing the middle leaves two
   pieces. mode='whole' instead removes the ENTIRE assignment wherever it overlaps this
   column, leaving a blank column and empty slots wherever that assignment used to
   extend. Either way, a person's assignment is skipped (left untouched) if the clicked
   slot is locked for them. */
function clearTimeColumn(slotIndex, mode){
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  pushUndoSnapshot();
  const nextAssignments = [];
  for(const a of state.assignments){
    const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
    if(!occ.includes(slotIndex)){ nextAssignments.push(a); continue; }
    const protectedHere = isCellLocked(sched, a.personId, slotIndex) || sched.lockedCells.has(cellKeyFor(a.personId, a.startSlot));
    if(protectedHere){ nextAssignments.push(a); continue; }
    if(mode==='whole') continue; // drop the whole assignment
    // mode==='split': keep whatever falls before/after the cleared slot as separate pieces.
    const leftLen = slotIndex - a.startSlot;
    const rightStart = slotIndex + 1;
    const rightLen = (a.startSlot + a.slotCount) - rightStart;
    if(leftLen > 0) nextAssignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:a.personId, positionId:a.positionId, startSlot:a.startSlot, slotCount:leftLen });
    if(rightLen > 0) nextAssignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:a.personId, positionId:a.positionId, startSlot:rightStart, slotCount:rightLen });
  }
  sched.assignments = nextAssignments;
  state.assignments = nextAssignments;
  renderAll();
}

/* ---------------- Row clipboard (copy/paste a whole person's row, program-level) ---------------- */
var rowClipboard = null; // { sourceName, items: [{positionId, startSlot, slotCount}] } — not tied to a schedule, so it works across tabs.
function copyPersonRow(personId){
  const items = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId).map(a=>({ positionId:a.positionId, startSlot:a.startSlot, slotCount:a.slotCount }));
  rowClipboard = { sourceName: personName(personId), items };
  showToast(`Copied ${personName(personId)}'s row (${items.length} assignment${items.length===1?'':'s'}). Paste it onto any person, in any schedule.`);
}
function pastePersonRow(personId){
  if(!rowClipboard) return;
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  pushUndoSnapshot();
  let next = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId!==personId || isCellLocked(sched, personId, a.startSlot));
  sched.assignments = next;
  state.assignments = next;
  let placed = 0, skipped = 0;
  for(const item of rowClipboard.items){
    const occ = range(item.startSlot, item.startSlot+item.slotCount-1);
    if(occ.some(s=>isCellLocked(sched, personId, s))){ skipped++; continue; }
    const check = isValidPlacement(personId, item.positionId, item.startSlot, { durSlots:item.slotCount });
    if(!check.ok){ skipped++; continue; }
    state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId, positionId:item.positionId, startSlot:item.startSlot, slotCount:item.slotCount });
    placed++;
  }
  renderAll();
  showToast(`Pasted ${rowClipboard.sourceName}'s row onto ${personName(personId)} — ${placed} placed${skipped ? `, ${skipped} skipped (locked or blocked by a rule)` : ''}.`);
}

/* ---------------- Position clipboard (cut/copy/paste a single filled assignment) ---------------- */
var positionClipboard = null; // { positionId, slotCount }
function cutAssignment(assignmentId){
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===assignmentId);
  if(!a) return;
  positionClipboard = { positionId:a.positionId, slotCount:a.slotCount };
  pushUndoSnapshot();
  const next = state.assignments.filter(x=>x.id!==assignmentId);
  activeSchedule().assignments = next;
  state.assignments = next;
  renderAll();
  showToast(`Cut ${positionName(a.positionId)} — click an empty slot, then Paste.`);
}
function copyAssignment(assignmentId){
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===assignmentId);
  if(!a) return;
  positionClipboard = { positionId:a.positionId, slotCount:a.slotCount };
  showToast(`Copied ${positionName(a.positionId)} — click an empty slot, then Paste.`);
}
function pastePositionAt(personId, slotIndex){
  if(!positionClipboard) return;
  const check = isValidPlacement(personId, positionClipboard.positionId, slotIndex, { durSlots:positionClipboard.slotCount });
  if(!check.ok){ alert(`Can't paste here: ${check.reason}`); return; }
  pushUndoSnapshot();
  state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId, positionId:positionClipboard.positionId, startSlot:slotIndex, slotCount:positionClipboard.slotCount });
  renderAll();
}

function previewLockedForClone(){
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  document.getElementById('duty-board').classList.add('lock-preview-active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-row-label').forEach(el=>{
    if(sched.lockedPeople.has(el.dataset.personId)) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-time-head[data-slot]').forEach(el=>{
    if(sched.lockedSlots.has(Number(el.dataset.slot))) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-cell').forEach(el=>{
    const pid = el.dataset.person, s = Number(el.dataset.slot);
    if(isCellLocked(sched, pid, s)) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-block.confirmed').forEach(el=>{
    const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===el.dataset.assignmentId);
    if(a && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>isCellLocked(sched, a.personId, s))) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
}
function clearLockPreview(){
  document.getElementById('duty-board').classList.remove('lock-preview-active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.lock-preview').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('lock-preview'));
}

/* ================================================================

   ================================================================ */
function showToast(msg){
  const layer = document.getElementById('toast-layer');
  layer.innerHTML = '';
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.className = 'db-toast';
  t.textContent = msg;
  layer.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(()=>{ t.remove(); }, 4800);
}

   People/Positions tabs' "Tags" column headers and the rule builder's tag links. */

/* ---- People tab ---- */
function renderPeopleTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const personTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='person');
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">People can be tagged with attributes (e.g. Male / Female / Bilingual) so rules can target a group instead of one individual. The roster below is shared by every schedule tab.</div>
    <table class="db-mini-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th id="people-tags-header" style="cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;" title="View person tags in the Tags tab">Tags</th><th>Qualifications</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="people-tbody"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="db-field grow"><label>New person name</label><input type="text" id="new-person-name" placeholder="e.g. Jordan"/></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="add-person-btn">Add person</button>
    </div>`;
  document.getElementById('people-tags-header').addEventListener('click', ()=>jumpToTags('person'));
  const tbody = document.getElementById('people-tbody');
  state.people.forEach(p=>{
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.dataset.personRow = p.id;
    const tagsHtml = personTags.map(t=>{
      const on = p.tags.includes(t.id);
      const style = on ? `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};` : '';
      return `<span class="db-chip-toggle ${on?'on':''}" style="${style}" data-person="${p.id}" data-tag="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span>`;
    }).join('');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</td>
      <td><div class="db-chip-set">${tagsHtml || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">no person tags defined</span>'}</div></td>
      <td><button class="db-icon-btn" data-qual-person="${p.id}" title="Review positions">▦</button></td>
      <td style="white-space:nowrap;"><button class="db-icon-btn" data-info-person="${p.id}" title="Personal details">ⓘ</button> <button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-person="${p.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('.db-chip-toggle').forEach(chip=>{
    chip.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const pid = chip.dataset.person, tid = chip.dataset.tag;
      const person = state.people.find(p=>p.id===pid);
      if(person.tags.includes(tid)) person.tags = person.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid);
      else person.tags.push(tid);
      renderPeopleTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-qual-person]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e)=>openQualificationsPopup(e, btn.dataset.qualPerson));
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-info-person]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e)=>openPersonInfoPopup(e, btn.dataset.infoPerson));
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-person]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const pid = btn.dataset.delPerson;
      if(!confirm('Delete this person? Their assignments will also be removed from every schedule.')) return;
      state.people = state.people.filter(p=>p.id!==pid);
      state.schedules.forEach(s=>{ s.assignments = s.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId!==pid); });
      state.assignments = activeSchedule().assignments;
      renderPeopleTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('add-person-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const input = document.getElementById('new-person-name');
    const name = input.value.trim();
    if(!name) return;
    state.people.push({ id:genId('p'), name, tags:[] });
    renderPeopleTab(); renderAll();
  });
}

/* ---- Qualifications (People tab) ----
   A "qualification" is just a plain Anytime standard rule for one exact person+position
   pair, stored the normal way in the current schedule's rules — no separate data model.
   The three states are mutually exclusive, so changing one clears any other rule that
   matches this exact shape first. */
function qualificationRulesFor(personId, positionId){
  return state.rules.filter(r=>r.kind!=='relative' && r.person && r.person.mode==='id' && r.person.value===personId &&
    r.position && r.position.mode==='id' && r.position.value===positionId && r.slot && r.slot.mode==='any');
}
function currentQualificationState(personId, positionId){
  const rules = qualificationRulesFor(personId, positionId);
  for(const r of rules){
    if(r.strength==='required' && r.effect==='forbid') return 'cannot';
    if(r.strength==='preferred' && r.effect==='forbid') return 'preferredNot';
    if(r.strength==='preferred' && r.effect==='require') return 'preferred';
  }
  return 'none';
}
function setQualification(personId, positionId, newState){
  const existing = qualificationRulesFor(personId, positionId);
  if(existing.length){
    const remove = new Set(existing.map(r=>r.id));
    state.rules = state.rules.filter(r=>!remove.has(r.id));
    activeSchedule().rules = state.rules;
  }
  const base = { id:genId('rule'), kind:'standard', active:true, nickname:'',
    person:{mode:'id', value:personId}, position:{mode:'id', value:positionId}, slot:{mode:'any'}, tags:[] };
  if(newState==='cannot') state.rules.push({ ...base, strength:'required', effect:'forbid' });
  else if(newState==='preferredNot') state.rules.push({ ...base, strength:'preferred', effect:'forbid' });
  else if(newState==='preferred') state.rules.push({ ...base, strength:'preferred', effect:'require' });
}
function refreshQualRow(row, personId, positionId){
  const current = currentQualificationState(personId, positionId);
  row.querySelectorAll('.db-qual-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.state===current));
}
function openQualificationsPopup(e, personId){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const person = state.people.find(p=>p.id===personId);
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup db-qual-popup';
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">Qualifications — ${escapeHtml(person.name)}</div>
    <div class="rule-hint">Cannot / Preferred not / Preferred create or update an Anytime rule for that exact person and position, in the current schedule tab. Selecting one clears any other for that same position.</div>
    <div class="db-qual-list" id="qual-list"></div>`;
  const list = pop.querySelector('#qual-list');
  state.positions.forEach(pos=>{
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'db-qual-row';
    const current = currentQualificationState(personId, pos.id);
    row.innerHTML = `<span class="db-qual-pos-name">${escapeHtml(pos.name)}</span>
      <span class="db-qual-btns">
        <button type="button" class="db-qual-btn cannot ${current==='cannot'?'on':''}" data-state="cannot">Cannot</button>
        <button type="button" class="db-qual-btn prefnot ${current==='preferredNot'?'on':''}" data-state="preferredNot">Preferred Not</button>
        <button type="button" class="db-qual-btn pref ${current==='preferred'?'on':''}" data-state="preferred">Preferred</button>
      </span>`;
    row.querySelectorAll('.db-qual-btn').forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        pushUndoSnapshot();
        const wantState = btn.dataset.state;
        const already = btn.classList.contains('on');
        setQualification(personId, pos.id, already ? 'none' : wantState);
        refreshQualRow(row, personId, pos.id);
        renderAll();
      });
    });
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

/* ---- Person info (People tab) — free-text notes stored on the person record itself,
   so they persist and round-trip through the same save/load path as everything else. ---- */
function openPersonInfoPopup(e, personId){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const person = state.people.find(p=>p.id===personId);
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
  pop.style.width = '280px';
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">${escapeHtml(person.name)} — personal details</div>
    <textarea id="person-info-textarea" rows="5" style="width:100%;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:12.5px;resize:vertical;" placeholder="Notes only you can see here — allergies, availability quirks, preferences, etc.">${escapeHtml(person.notes||'')}</textarea>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="person-info-save" style="width:100%;">Save</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  const save = ()=>{ person.notes = pop.querySelector('#person-info-textarea').value; persist(); };
  pop.querySelector('#person-info-save').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    save();
    closeFloating();
    showToast(`Saved details for ${person.name}.`);
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)){ save(); closeFloating(); } });
}

/* ---- Positions tab ---- */

/* Finds the first rule (in any schedule) that references this position directly by
   id — either as its main target or as a relative rule's "other position" — so
   deleting the position wouldn't silently break it. Only the first match is
   returned, even if several rules reference it. */
function findRuleConflictForPosition(positionId){
  for(const sched of state.schedules){
    for(const rule of sched.rules){
      if(rule.position && rule.position.mode==='id' && rule.position.value===positionId) return { rule, sched };
      if(rule.kind==='relative' && rule.relative && rule.relative.otherPosition && rule.relative.otherPosition.mode==='id' && rule.relative.otherPosition.value===positionId){
        return { rule, sched };
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}
function performDeletePosition(posId){
  state.positions = state.positions.filter(p=>p.id!==posId);
  state.schedules.forEach(s=>{ s.assignments = s.assignments.filter(a=>a.positionId!==posId); });
  state.assignments = activeSchedule().assignments;
  renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
}
function openPositionDeleteWarning(posId, conflict, anchorEl){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
  pop.style.width = '260px';
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">"${escapeHtml(positionName(posId))}" is used by a rule</div>
    <div class="rule-hint" id="warn-rule-text"></div>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="warn-nevermind">Nevermind</button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger-outline" id="warn-delete">Delete assignment</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="warn-view-rule" style="width:100%;">View Rule</button></div>`;
  pop.querySelector('#warn-rule-text').innerHTML = ruleNicknamePrefix(conflict.rule) + escapeHtml(ruleLabel(conflict.rule));
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  pop.querySelector('#warn-nevermind').addEventListener('click', closeFloating);
  pop.querySelector('#warn-delete').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeFloating(); performDeletePosition(posId); });
  pop.querySelector('#warn-view-rule').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    if(conflict.sched.id!==state.activeScheduleId) setActiveSchedule(conflict.sched.id);
    openSettings('rules', conflict.rule.id);
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function renderPositionsTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const posTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='position');
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">Positions occupy consecutive ${SLOT_MINUTES}‑minute slots. Give a position a duration range and its blocks on the chart can be dragged wider or narrower within that range; "Preferred" is the duration new assignments default to. "Single‑person" positions can only hold one person at a time; otherwise multiple people can share a position at once. "Display" is the short label shown on the chart itself (the full name is still used everywhere else). Shared by every schedule tab.</div>
    <table class="db-mini-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Display</th><th>Min</th><th>Preferred</th><th>Max</th><th>Single‑person</th><th>Fill color</th><th>Text color</th><th id="positions-tags-header" style="cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;" title="View position tags in the Tags tab">Tags</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="positions-tbody"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="db-field"><label>New position name</label><input type="text" id="new-position-name" placeholder="e.g. Greeter"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Display</label><input type="text" id="new-position-display" maxlength="8" placeholder="e.g. GR" style="width:64px;"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Min duration (min)</label><input type="number" id="new-position-duration-min" value="${SLOT_MINUTES}" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Max duration (min)</label><input type="number" id="new-position-duration-max" value="${SLOT_MINUTES}" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Fill color</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-position-color" value="#3b6fd6"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Text color</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-position-text-color" value="#FFFFFF"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field checkbox"><input type="checkbox" id="new-position-single"/><label>Single‑person</label></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="add-position-btn">Add position</button>
    </div>`;
  document.getElementById('positions-tags-header').addEventListener('click', ()=>jumpToTags('position'));
  const tbody = document.getElementById('positions-tbody');
  const inputStyle = 'width:58px;padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;';
  state.positions.forEach(pos=>{
    if(pos.preferredDuration===undefined) pos.preferredDuration = pos.durationMin;
    if(pos.textColor===undefined) pos.textColor = '#FFFFFF';
    if(pos.display===undefined) pos.display = '';
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    const tagsHtml = posTags.map(t=>{
      const on = pos.tags.includes(t.id);
      const style = on ? `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};` : '';
      return `<span class="db-chip-toggle ${on?'on':''}" style="${style}" data-position="${pos.id}" data-tag="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span>`;
    }).join('');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(pos.name)}</td>
      <td><input type="text" maxlength="8" value="${escapeHtml(pos.display)}" placeholder="${escapeHtml(pos.name.slice(0,4))}" data-display="${pos.id}" style="width:60px;padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;background:${pos.color};color:${pos.textColor};"/></td>
      <td><input type="number" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}" value="${pos.durationMin}" data-dur-min="${pos.id}" style="${inputStyle}"/></td>
      <td><input type="number" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}" value="${pos.preferredDuration}" data-dur-pref="${pos.id}" style="${inputStyle}"/></td>
      <td><input type="number" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}" value="${pos.durationMax}" data-dur-max="${pos.id}" style="${inputStyle}"/></td>
      <td><input type="checkbox" data-single="${pos.id}" ${pos.singlePerson?'checked':''}/></td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${pos.color}" data-color="${pos.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${pos.textColor}" data-text-color="${pos.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><div class="db-chip-set">${tagsHtml || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">no position tags defined</span>'}</div></td>
      <td style="white-space:nowrap;"><button class="db-icon-btn" data-edit-position="${pos.id}" title="Rename or copy this position">✎</button> <button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-position="${pos.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  function clampDuration(pos){
    pos.durationMin = Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Math.round(pos.durationMin/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    pos.durationMax = Math.max(pos.durationMin, Math.round(pos.durationMax/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    pos.preferredDuration = Math.min(pos.durationMax, Math.max(pos.durationMin, Math.round((pos.preferredDuration||pos.durationMin)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES));
  }
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-display]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.display);
      pos.display = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-dur-min]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.durMin);
      pos.durationMin = Number(inp.value)||SLOT_MINUTES;
      clampDuration(pos);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-dur-max]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.durMax);
      pos.durationMax = Number(inp.value)||SLOT_MINUTES;
      clampDuration(pos);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-dur-pref]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.durPref);
      pos.preferredDuration = Number(inp.value)||pos.durationMin;
      clampDuration(pos);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-single]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.single).singlePerson = inp.checked;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.color);
      pos.color = inp.value;
      const displayTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-display="${pos.id}"]`);
      if(displayTwin) displayTwin.style.background = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-text-color]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.textColor);
      pos.textColor = inp.value;
      const displayTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-display="${pos.id}"]`);
      if(displayTwin) displayTwin.style.color = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('.db-chip-toggle').forEach(chip=>{
    chip.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const posId = chip.dataset.position, tid = chip.dataset.tag;
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===posId);
      if(pos.tags.includes(tid)) pos.tags = pos.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid);
      else pos.tags.push(tid);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-position]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e)=>openPositionEditPopup(e, btn.dataset.editPosition));
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-position]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const posId = btn.dataset.delPosition;
      const conflict = findRuleConflictForPosition(posId);
      if(conflict){
        openPositionDeleteWarning(posId, conflict, btn);
        return;
      }
      if(!confirm('Delete this position? Its assignments will also be removed from every schedule.')) return;
      performDeletePosition(posId);
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('add-position-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const name = document.getElementById('new-position-name').value.trim();
    if(!name) return;
    const display = document.getElementById('new-position-display').value.trim();
    const durationMin = Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Math.round(Number(document.getElementById('new-position-duration-min').value)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    const durationMax = Math.max(durationMin, Math.round(Number(document.getElementById('new-position-duration-max').value)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    const color = document.getElementById('new-position-color').value;
    const textColor = document.getElementById('new-position-text-color').value;
    const single = document.getElementById('new-position-single').checked;
    state.positions.push({ id:genId('pos'), name, display, durationMin, durationMax, preferredDuration:durationMin, singlePerson:single, color, textColor, tags:[] });
    renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
  });
}

/* Rename a position, or duplicate it (all settings and tags included) as a starting
   point for numbered variants — this is what the "X to Clone" preset positions are
   for: copy the template, then rename the copy's Display (e.g. "EOB-#" -> "EOB-1"). */
function openPositionEditPopup(e, posId){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===posId);
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
  pop.style.width = '250px';
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">Edit position</div>
    <div class="db-field grow" style="margin-bottom:8px;"><label>Name</label><input type="text" id="pos-edit-name" value="${escapeHtml(pos.name)}" style="width:100%;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;"/></div>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="pos-edit-save" style="width:100%;">Save name</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pos-edit-copy" style="width:100%;">📋 Copy this position</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  pop.querySelector('#pos-edit-save').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const val = pop.querySelector('#pos-edit-name').value.trim();
    if(val){ pos.name = val; closeFloating(); renderPositionsTab(); renderAll(); }
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pos-edit-copy').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const copy = { ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pos)), id: genId('pos'), name: `${pos.name} (copy)` };
    state.positions.push(copy);
    closeFloating(); renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    showToast(`Copied "${pos.name}" as "${copy.name}" — all settings and tags carried over.`);
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

/* ---- Tags tab ---- */
function renderTagsTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const palette = nextTagPalette();
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">Tags classify people, positions, or rules (e.g. "Female", "Physically demanding", "Coverage") so rules can target a group instead of one individual, and so rules can be grouped for searching. Each tag's colors control how it's shown as a chip throughout the app.</div>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
      <div class="db-field"><label>Show</label>
        <select id="tags-type-filter">
          <option value="all">All tag types</option>
          <option value="person">People tags</option>
          <option value="position">Position tags</option>
          <option value="rule">Rule tags</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <table class="db-mini-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Applies to</th><th>Highlight</th><th>Text</th><th>Preview</th><th>Used by</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="tags-tbody"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="db-field"><label>New tag name</label><input type="text" id="new-tag-name" placeholder="e.g. Bilingual"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Applies to</label>
        <select id="new-tag-category"><option value="person">People</option><option value="position">Positions</option><option value="rule">Rules</option></select>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Highlight</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-tag-highlight" value="${palette.bg}"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Text</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-tag-text" value="${palette.text}"/></div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="add-tag-btn">Add tag</button>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Preview</label><span class="db-tag-pill" id="new-tag-preview" style="background:${palette.bg};color:${palette.text};">Preview</span></div>
    </div>`;
  document.getElementById('tags-type-filter').value = tagsTabFilter;
  document.getElementById('tags-type-filter').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    tagsTabFilter = e.target.value;
    renderTagsTab();
  });
  const newTagPreview = document.getElementById('new-tag-preview');
  const refreshNewTagPreview = ()=>{
    newTagPreview.style.background = document.getElementById('new-tag-highlight').value;
    newTagPreview.style.color = document.getElementById('new-tag-text').value;
    const name = document.getElementById('new-tag-name').value.trim();
    newTagPreview.textContent = name || 'Preview';
  };
  ['new-tag-highlight','new-tag-text','new-tag-name'].forEach(id=>{
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input', refreshNewTagPreview);
  });
  const categoryLabel = c => c==='person' ? 'People' : c==='position' ? 'Positions' : 'Rules';
  const tbody = document.getElementById('tags-tbody');
  const visibleTags = state.tags.filter(t=>tagsTabFilter==='all' || t.category===tagsTabFilter);
  if(visibleTags.length===0){
    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="db-empty-note">No ${tagsTabFilter==='all'?'':categoryLabel(tagsTabFilter).toLowerCase()+' '}tags yet.</td></tr>`;
  }
  visibleTags.forEach(t=>{
    const usageCount = t.category==='person'
      ? state.people.filter(p=>p.tags.includes(t.id)).length
      : t.category==='position'
        ? state.positions.filter(p=>p.tags.includes(t.id)).length
        : state.schedules.reduce((sum,s)=>sum + s.rules.filter(r=>(r.tags||[]).includes(t.id)).length, 0);
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(t.name)}</td>
      <td>${categoryLabel(t.category)}</td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${t.highlightColor}" data-tag-highlight="${t.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${t.textColor}" data-tag-text="${t.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><span class="db-tag-pill" id="tag-preview-${t.id}" style="background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span></td>
      <td>${usageCount}</td>
      <td><button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-tag="${t.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-tag-highlight]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===inp.dataset.tagHighlight);
      t.highlightColor = inp.value;
      const preview = document.getElementById(`tag-preview-${t.id}`);
      if(preview) preview.style.background = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-tag-text]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===inp.dataset.tagText);
      t.textColor = inp.value;
      const preview = document.getElementById(`tag-preview-${t.id}`);
      if(preview) preview.style.color = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-tag]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const tid = btn.dataset.delTag;
      const usedByRules = state.schedules.some(s=>s.rules.some(r=>
        (r.person && r.person.value===tid) || (r.position && r.position.value===tid) || (r.tags||[]).includes(tid) ||
        (r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && (
          (r.relative.otherPosition && r.relative.otherPosition.value===tid) ||
          (r.relative.otherPerson && r.relative.otherPerson.value===tid)
        )) ||
        (r.person && (r.person.requiredTags||[]).includes(tid)) || (r.person && (r.person.prohibitedTags||[]).includes(tid))
      ));
      if(!confirm(`Delete this tag? It will be removed from all people/positions/rules${usedByRules ? ' — some rules reference it and will stop matching anything' : ''}.`)) return;
      state.tags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.id!==tid);
      state.people.forEach(p=>{ p.tags = p.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid); });
      state.positions.forEach(p=>{ p.tags = p.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid); });
      state.schedules.forEach(s=>{ s.rules.forEach(r=>{ r.tags = (r.tags||[]).filter(x=>x!==tid); }); });
      renderTagsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('add-tag-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const name = document.getElementById('new-tag-name').value.trim();
    const category = document.getElementById('new-tag-category').value;
    const highlightColor = document.getElementById('new-tag-highlight').value;
    const textColor = document.getElementById('new-tag-text').value;
    if(!name) return;
    state.tags.push({ id:genId('tag'), name, category, highlightColor, textColor });
    renderTagsTab();
  });
}

/* ---- Time range tab ---- */
function renderTimeTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const stepSeconds = SLOT_MINUTES*60;
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">Times snap to ${SLOT_MINUTES}‑minute slots. The time range is shared by every schedule tab; shrinking it removes any assignments (in any tab) that fall outside it.</div>
    <div class="db-field-row">
      <div class="db-field"><label>Start time</label><input type="time" id="range-start" value="${minutesToTimeInput(state.settings.startMinutes)}" step="${stepSeconds}"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>End time</label><input type="time" id="range-end" value="${minutesToTimeInput(state.settings.endMinutes)}" step="${stepSeconds}"/></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="apply-range-btn">Apply</button>
    </div>
    <div class="db-rule-preview"><span class="lbl">Current range</span>${getSlots().length} slots · ${formatTime(state.settings.startMinutes)} – ${formatTime(state.settings.endMinutes)}</div>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:16px;">
      <div class="db-field"><label>Maximum unfilled time (min)</label><input type="number" id="max-unfilled-minutes" min="0" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}" value="${state.settings.maxUnfilledMinutes}"/></div>
    </div>
    <div class="db-help-text">"Fill unlocked" and "Fill all" will leave gaps up to this size alone instead of forcing something into every last hole. Gaps larger than this are still filled if anything can go there.</div>`;
  document.getElementById('apply-range-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const startVal = document.getElementById('range-start').value;
    const endVal = document.getElementById('range-end').value;
    if(!startVal || !endVal) return;
    let startMin = Math.round(timeInputToMinutes(startVal)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES;
    let endMin = Math.round(timeInputToMinutes(endVal)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES;
    if(endMin<=startMin){ alert('End time must be after start time.'); return; }
    state.settings.startMinutes = startMin;
    state.settings.endMinutes = endMin;
    const totalSlots = Math.round((endMin-startMin)/SLOT_MINUTES);
    state.schedules.forEach(s=>{
      s.assignments = s.assignments.filter(a=>a.startSlot>=0 && a.startSlot+a.slotCount<=totalSlots);
    });
    state.assignments = activeSchedule().assignments;
    renderTimeTab(); renderAll();
  });
  document.getElementById('max-unfilled-minutes').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    state.settings.maxUnfilledMinutes = Math.max(0, Math.round((Number(e.target.value)||0)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    e.target.value = state.settings.maxUnfilledMinutes;
    persist();
  });
}

const WEEKDAY_NAMES = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
function renderSchedulesTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const s = state.settings;
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">These control how new schedule tabs are named and managed — cloning, loading a file, or hitting a schedule-count limit.</div>

    <div class="db-rule-builder">
      <h3>Clone origin</h3>
      <div class="db-field-row">
        <div class="db-field"><label>Show "(clone of …)" as</label>
          <select id="sched-clone-origin">
            <option value="right">Right of name</option>
            <option value="under">Under name</option>
            <option value="hidden">Hidden</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="db-rule-builder">
      <h3>Auto-delete</h3>
      <div class="db-field-row">
        <div class="db-field checkbox"><input type="checkbox" id="sched-auto-delete" ${s.autoDeleteEnabled?'checked':''}/><label>Delete the oldest schedule when a new one is made and the limit is exceeded</label></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field-row">
        <div class="db-field"><label>Max number of schedules</label><input type="number" id="sched-max-count" min="1" step="1" value="${s.maxSchedules}"/></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="db-rule-builder">
      <h3>Auto-name new clones</h3>
      <div class="db-field-row">
        <div class="db-field"><label>Name new clones with</label>
          <select id="sched-auto-name-mode">
            <option value="today">Today's date</option>
            <option value="nextWeekday">Next day of week</option>
            <option value="cloneName">Same name as clone source</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="db-field" id="sched-weekday-wrap" style="display:none;"><label>Day of week</label>
          <select id="sched-auto-name-weekday">
            ${WEEKDAY_NAMES.map((n,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${n}</option>`).join('')}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="db-field checkbox" id="sched-ignore-today-wrap" style="display:none;">
          <input type="checkbox" id="sched-ignore-today" ${s.autoNameIgnoreToday!==false?'checked':''}/>
          <label>Ignore today (if today is that weekday, use next week instead)</label>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-help-text" id="sched-auto-name-hint" style="margin-top:0;"></div>
    </div>`;

  document.getElementById('sched-clone-origin').value = s.cloneOriginDisplay || 'under';
  document.getElementById('sched-auto-name-mode').value = s.autoNameMode || 'nextWeekday';
  document.getElementById('sched-auto-name-weekday').value = s.autoNameWeekday!==undefined ? s.autoNameWeekday : 4;

  function updateAutoNameFieldsVisibility(){
    const mode = document.getElementById('sched-auto-name-mode').value;
    document.getElementById('sched-weekday-wrap').style.display = mode==='nextWeekday' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('sched-ignore-today-wrap').style.display = mode==='nextWeekday' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    const hints = {
      today: 'A new clone is named after today\u2019s date, e.g. "8/15/26".',
      nextWeekday: 'A new clone is named after the next occurrence of the chosen weekday. With "Ignore today" on, a clone made ON that weekday is named a week out instead of today.',
      cloneName: 'A new clone keeps the same name as the schedule it was cloned from, with "(2)", "(3)", etc. added if that name is already taken.',
    };
    document.getElementById('sched-auto-name-hint').textContent = hints[mode] || '';
  }
  updateAutoNameFieldsVisibility();

  document.getElementById('sched-clone-origin').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    state.settings.cloneOriginDisplay = e.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });
  document.getElementById('sched-auto-delete').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    state.settings.autoDeleteEnabled = e.target.checked;
    persist();
  });
  document.getElementById('sched-max-count').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    state.settings.maxSchedules = Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)||5);
    e.target.value = state.settings.maxSchedules;
    persist();
  });
  document.getElementById('sched-auto-name-mode').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    state.settings.autoNameMode = e.target.value;
    updateAutoNameFieldsVisibility();
    persist();
  });
  document.getElementById('sched-auto-name-weekday').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    state.settings.autoNameWeekday = Number(e.target.value);
    persist();
  });
  document.getElementById('sched-ignore-today').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    state.settings.autoNameIgnoreToday = e.target.checked;
    persist();
  });
}

/* ---- Rules tab (builder + list) ---- */
/* ================================================================
   NATURAL-LANGUAGE RULE BUILDER — shared bubble widgets
   ================================================================
   A rule reads as a row of "bubbles". Each bubble's arrow (▾) reopens a small
   floating list of alternatives for that piece; the rest of the bubble is live
   content (a number, a name, a tag combo) when the piece has any. Unselected
   options in an open list render gray, the current selection black. Choosing a
   new option on an earlier bubble re-renders the whole sentence from the shape's
   current draft, so anything downstream that's no longer compatible resets. */

function bubbleEl(labelText, onArrowClick, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const b = document.createElement('span');
  b.className = 'db-bubble' + (opts.unset ? ' unset' : '');
  const content = document.createElement('span');
  content.className = 'db-bubble-content';
  if(opts.contentEl) content.appendChild(opts.contentEl); else content.textContent = labelText;
  b.appendChild(content);
  if(onArrowClick){
    const arrow = document.createElement('button');
    arrow.type = 'button'; arrow.className = 'db-bubble-arrow'; arrow.textContent = '▾';
    arrow.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); onArrowClick(arrow); });
    b.appendChild(arrow);
  }
  return { el:b, content };
}
function staticTextEl(text){ const s = document.createElement('span'); s.className = 'db-bubble-static'; s.textContent = text; return s; }
function addChipEl(label, onClick){
  const c = document.createElement('button');
  c.type = 'button'; c.className = 'db-bubble-add'; c.textContent = label;
  c.addEventListener('click', onClick);
  return c;
}
/* Floating vertical option list, anchored under whatever bubble/arrow/chip was clicked. */
function openBubbleMenu(anchorEl, options, currentValue, onSelect, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const menu = document.createElement('div');
  menu.className = 'db-bubble-menu';
  let searchInput = null;
  if(opts.searchable && options.length>8){
    searchInput = document.createElement('input');
    searchInput.className = 'db-bubble-menu-search';
    searchInput.placeholder = 'Search…';
    menu.appendChild(searchInput);
  }
  const list = document.createElement('div');
  menu.appendChild(list);
  function renderList(filter){
    list.innerHTML = '';
    const shown = options.filter(o=>!filter || o.label.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()));
    if(shown.length===0){
      const none = document.createElement('div');
      none.className = 'db-bubble-option'; none.style.color = '#c3cad6'; none.style.cursor = 'default';
      none.textContent = 'No matches';
      list.appendChild(none);
      return;
    }
    shown.forEach(o=>{
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'db-bubble-option' + (o.value===currentValue ? ' selected' : '');
      btn.textContent = o.label;
      btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeFloating(); onSelect(o.value); });
      list.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }
  renderList('');
  if(searchInput) searchInput.addEventListener('input', ()=>renderList(searchInput.value));
  layer.appendChild(menu);
  positionFloating(menu, anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect());
  if(searchInput) setTimeout(()=>searchInput.focus(), 0);
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!menu.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

/* ---- Tag-combination follow-up: "+ tagged …" / "+ but not …", each addable more
   than once, so a target can read e.g. tagged "hardworking", not "trained". ---- */
function renderTagComboFollowup(container, tagFilter, category, onChange){
  const allTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category===category);
  const reqList = tagFilter.required||[], prohList = tagFilter.prohibited||[];
  reqList.forEach((tid,i)=>{
    const word = i===0 ? 'tagged' : 'and tagged';
    const chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'db-tag-combo-chip';
    chip.innerHTML = `${word} \u201c${escapeHtml(tagName(tid))}\u201d <button type="button" class="rm">✕</button>`;
    chip.querySelector('.rm').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ tagFilter.required = tagFilter.required.filter(x=>x!==tid); onChange(); });
    container.appendChild(chip);
  });
  prohList.forEach((tid,i)=>{
    const word = i===0 ? (reqList.length ? 'but not' : 'not') : 'nor';
    const chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'db-tag-combo-chip';
    chip.innerHTML = `${word} tagged \u201c${escapeHtml(tagName(tid))}\u201d <button type="button" class="rm">✕</button>`;
    chip.querySelector('.rm').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ tagFilter.prohibited = tagFilter.prohibited.filter(x=>x!==tid); onChange(); });
    container.appendChild(chip);
  });
  const addOne = (label, key)=>addChipEl(label, (e)=>{
    const already = new Set([...(tagFilter.required||[]), ...(tagFilter.prohibited||[])]);
    const options = allTags.filter(t=>!already.has(t.id)).map(t=>({value:t.id, label:t.name}));
    if(options.length===0){ showToast('No more tags to add.'); return; }
    openBubbleMenu(e.currentTarget, options, null, (val)=>{
      tagFilter[key] = [...(tagFilter[key]||[]), val];
      onChange();
    });
  });
  const addReqLabel = reqList.length ? '+ and tagged…' : '+ tagged…';
  const addProhLabel = prohList.length ? '+ nor tagged…' : (reqList.length ? '+ but not tagged…' : '+ not tagged…');
  container.appendChild(addOne(addReqLabel, 'required'));
  container.appendChild(addOne(addProhLabel, 'prohibited'));
}

/* ---- Person/position target piece ----
   draft shape: { primary: 'specific'|'any'|'someone'|'everyone'|'noone', specificId,
                  tagFilter:{required:[],prohibited:[]}, count:{min,max} }
   'someone'/'everyone'/'noone' only make sense for person targets with require/forbid
   framing (shapes 1 & 9); plain person/position targets elsewhere just use
   'specific'/'any', with the tag combo as an optional refinement on 'any'. */
function targetDraftToField(t, kind){
  if(t.primary==='specific') return { mode:'id', value:t.specificId };
  const field = { mode:'any' };
  if((t.tagFilter.required||[]).length) field.requiredTags = t.tagFilter.required.slice();
  if((t.tagFilter.prohibited||[]).length) field.prohibitedTags = t.tagFilter.prohibited.slice();
  if(kind==='person' && t.primary==='someone') field.count = { min:t.count.min, max:t.count.max };
  if(kind==='person' && t.primary==='everyone') field.count = { min: Math.max(1,state.people.length), max: Math.max(1,state.people.length) };
  return field;
}
function fieldToTargetDraft(field, kind, ruleEffect){
  const blank = { primary:'any', specificId:null, tagFilter:{required:[],prohibited:[]}, count:{min:1,max:1} };
  if(!field) return blank;
  if(field.mode==='id') return { primary:'specific', specificId:field.value, tagFilter:{required:[],prohibited:[]}, count:{min:1,max:1} };
  if(field.mode==='tag') return { ...blank, tagFilter:{required:[field.value], prohibited:[]} }; // legacy single-tag position mode
  // mode 'any'
  const reqTags = field.requiredTags || [], prohTags = field.prohibitedTags || [];
  let primary = 'any';
  if(kind==='person'){
    if(field.count){
      const total = Math.max(1,state.people.length);
      primary = (field.count.min===total && field.count.max===total) ? 'everyone' : 'someone';
    } else {
      primary = ruleEffect==='forbid' ? 'noone' : 'any';
    }
  }
  return { primary, specificId:null, tagFilter:{required:reqTags.slice(), prohibited:prohTags.slice()}, count: field.count || {min:1,max:1} };
}
function renderTargetBubble(container, target, cfg, onChange){
  let mainLabel;
  if(target.primary==='specific'){
    const name = target.specificId ? (cfg.kind==='person' ? personName(target.specificId) : positionName(target.specificId)) : null;
    mainLabel = name || `choose a ${cfg.kind}`;
  } else {
    mainLabel = cfg.labels[target.primary] || target.primary;
  }
  const isUnset = target.primary==='specific' && !target.specificId;
  const { el } = bubbleEl(mainLabel, (arrowEl)=>{
    const options = cfg.primaryOptions.map(p=>({ value:p, label: cfg.labels[p] }));
    openBubbleMenu(arrowEl, options, target.primary, (val)=>{
      target.primary = val;
      if(val==='specific') target.specificId = null;
      if(cfg.requireTagWhenAny && val==='any' && (target.tagFilter.required||[]).length===0){
        // this shape doesn't allow a fully-unrestricted "any" — prompt for the first tag immediately
        const allTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category===cfg.tagCategory);
        if(allTags.length){
          openBubbleMenu(arrowEl, allTags.map(t=>({value:t.id, label:t.name})), null, (tv)=>{
            target.tagFilter.required = [tv];
            onChange();
          });
          return;
        }
      }
      onChange();
    });
  }, { unset:isUnset });
  el.style.cursor = 'pointer';
  el.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.target.classList.contains('db-bubble-arrow')) return;
    if(target.primary==='specific'){
      const options = (cfg.kind==='person' ? state.people : state.positions).map(p=>({value:p.id, label:p.name}));
      openBubbleMenu(el, options, target.specificId, (val)=>{ target.specificId = val; onChange(); }, {searchable:true});
    }
  });
  container.appendChild(el);
  if(cfg.allowCount && target.primary==='someone'){
    const total = Math.max(1,state.people.length);
    const cl = (target.count.min===target.count.max) ? `${target.count.min} ${target.count.min===1?'person':'people'}` : `${target.count.min}\u2013${target.count.max} people`;
    const { el: countBubble } = bubbleEl(`for ${cl}`, (arrowEl)=>openCountEditor(arrowEl, target.count, total, onChange));
    container.appendChild(countBubble);
  }
  if(target.primary!=='specific'){
    renderTagComboFollowup(container, target.tagFilter, cfg.tagCategory, onChange);
  }
}
function openCountEditor(anchorEl, count, total, onChange){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-bubble-menu'; pop.style.padding = '10px'; pop.style.minWidth = '190px';
  pop.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;">
    <input type="number" id="count-min-input" min="1" max="${total}" value="${count.min}" style="width:44px;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;"/>
    <span>to</span>
    <input type="number" id="count-max-input" min="1" max="${total}" value="${count.max}" style="width:44px;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;"/>
    <span>people</span>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" id="count-all-btn" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px;">All ${total} people</button>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect());
  const minInp = pop.querySelector('#count-min-input'), maxInp = pop.querySelector('#count-max-input');
  const commit = ()=>{
    count.min = Math.max(1, Math.min(total, Number(minInp.value)||1));
    count.max = Math.max(count.min, Math.min(total, Number(maxInp.value)||count.min));
    onChange();
  };
  minInp.addEventListener('change', commit);
  maxInp.addEventListener('change', commit);
  pop.querySelector('#count-all-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ count.min=total; count.max=total; closeFloating(); onChange(); });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)){ commit(); closeFloating(); } });
}

/* ---- Time piece: any / a specific slot / a range. Range end shows the CLOSE of
   that slot (not its start) so a range can visibly reach the schedule's actual
   closing time, matching the same fix applied to the manual builder. ---- */
function timeDraftToField(t){
  if(t.kind==='any') return {mode:'any'};
  if(t.kind==='specific') return {mode:'id', value:t.slotIndex};
  return {mode:'range', start:t.start, end:t.end};
}
function fieldToTimeDraft(field){
  if(!field || field.mode==='any') return {kind:'any', slotIndex:0, start:0, end:Math.max(0,getSlots().length-1)};
  if(field.mode==='id') return {kind:'specific', slotIndex:field.value, start:field.value, end:field.value};
  if(field.mode==='range') return {kind:'range', slotIndex:field.start, start:field.start, end:field.end};
  return {kind:'any', slotIndex:0, start:0, end:Math.max(0,getSlots().length-1)};
}
function renderTimeBubble(container, timeDraft, onChange, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const slots = getSlots();
  const primaryOptions = [{value:'any', label: opts.anyLabel || 'at any time'}, {value:'specific', label:'at a specific time'}, {value:'range', label:'during a range'}];
  let mainLabel;
  if(timeDraft.kind==='any') mainLabel = opts.anyLabel || 'at any time';
  else if(timeDraft.kind==='specific') mainLabel = slots[timeDraft.slotIndex] ? `at ${slots[timeDraft.slotIndex].label}` : 'at…';
  else mainLabel = (slots[timeDraft.start] && slots[timeDraft.end]!==undefined && slots[timeDraft.end]) ? `from ${slots[timeDraft.start].label} to ${formatTime(slots[timeDraft.end].minutes+SLOT_MINUTES)}` : 'during…';
  const { el } = bubbleEl(mainLabel, (arrowEl)=>{
    openBubbleMenu(arrowEl, primaryOptions, timeDraft.kind, (val)=>{
      timeDraft.kind = val;
      if(val==='specific' && timeDraft.slotIndex===undefined) timeDraft.slotIndex = 0;
      if(val==='range'){ if(timeDraft.start===undefined) timeDraft.start=0; if(timeDraft.end===undefined) timeDraft.end = Math.max(0,slots.length-1); }
      onChange();
    });
  });
  el.style.cursor = 'pointer';
  el.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.target.classList.contains('db-bubble-arrow')) return;
    if(timeDraft.kind==='specific'){
      const options = slots.map((s,i)=>({value:i, label:s.label}));
      openBubbleMenu(el, options, timeDraft.slotIndex, (val)=>{ timeDraft.slotIndex=Number(val); onChange(); }, {searchable:true});
    } else if(timeDraft.kind==='range'){
      openTimeRangeEditor(el, timeDraft, onChange);
    }
  });
  container.appendChild(el);
}
function openTimeRangeEditor(anchorEl, timeDraft, onChange){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = getFloatingLayer();
  const slots = getSlots();
  const startOpts = slots.map((s,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${i===timeDraft.start?'selected':''}>${s.label}</option>`).join('');
  const endOpts = slots.map((s,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${i===timeDraft.end?'selected':''}>${formatTime(s.minutes+SLOT_MINUTES)}</option>`).join('');
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-bubble-menu'; pop.style.padding = '10px'; pop.style.minWidth = '220px';
  pop.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;">
    <label>From<select id="range-start-sel" style="width:100%;margin-top:2px;">${startOpts}</select></label>
    <label>To<select id="range-end-sel" style="width:100%;margin-top:2px;">${endOpts}</select></label>
  </div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect());
  const startSel = pop.querySelector('#range-start-sel'), endSel = pop.querySelector('#range-end-sel');
  const commit = ()=>{
    let a = Number(startSel.value), b = Number(endSel.value);
    if(b<a){ const t=a; a=b; b=t; }
    timeDraft.start = a; timeDraft.end = b;
    onChange();
  };
  startSel.addEventListener('change', commit);
  endSel.addEventListener('change', commit);
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)){ commit(); closeFloating(); } });
}

/* ---- must / can't / should / shouldn't — one logical piece everywhere, though which
   of the four are offered (and their exact verb phrasing) varies by shape, and
   sometimes by another bubble's current choice (e.g. Who="no one" only pairs with
   forbid-flavored modals — see shape configs below). ---- */
function modalToStrengthEffect(modal){
  if(modal==='must') return {strength:'required', effect:'require'};
  if(modal==='cant') return {strength:'required', effect:'forbid'};
  if(modal==='should') return {strength:'preferred', effect:'require'};
  return {strength:'preferred', effect:'forbid'};
}
function strengthEffectToModal(strength, effect){
  if(strength==='required') return effect==='forbid' ? 'cant' : 'must';
  return effect==='forbid' ? 'shouldnt' : 'should';
}
function modalWord(modal, isNegative){
  if(modal==='must') return 'must';
  if(modal==='should') return 'should';
  if(modal==='cant') return isNegative ? 'can' : 'can\u2019t';
  return isNegative ? 'should' : 'shouldn\u2019t'; // 'shouldnt'
}

/* ================================================================
   NATURAL-LANGUAGE RULE BUILDER
   ================================================================
   The sentence builds up one bubble at a time with nothing preselected: bubble 1
   ("subject") offers person AND position openers side by side; once it resolves,
   bubble 2 ("predicate") offers every applicable "verb phrase", filtered by what
   the subject was (a plain list, not a named-shape picker) — choosing one fixes
   which underlying rule "shape" is being built. Each further bubble only appears
   once the one before it has a value, and stops once the sentence is a complete,
   valid rule; purely optional refinements (tag combos, a person-count) still use
   their own "+" add-chips whenever they're available.

   'no one' is the one subject that is grammatically negative by itself, so its
   predicate options render with an affirmative verb ("No one CAN...", "No one
   SHOULD...") instead of can't/shouldn't, avoiding a double negative. */
var PREDICATE_DEFS = {
  assignment:     { dropdownVerb:'be scheduled for a position', restingVerb:'be scheduled for', reachableFrom:{person:['specific','someone','everyone','noone']} },
  together:       { dropdownVerb:'always be scheduled together with someone else', restingVerb:'always be scheduled together with', reachableFrom:{person:['specific','noone']} },
  sequence:       { dropdownVerb:'do one position right before or after another', restingVerb:'do', reachableFrom:{person:['specific','noone']} },
  limit:          { dropdownVerb:'have too much of one position', restingVerb:'have more than', reachableFrom:{person:['specific','noone']} },
  crossSchedule:  { dropdownVerb:'repeat the same assignment across schedules', restingVerb:'have the same assignment for more than', reachableFrom:{person:['specific','noone']} },
  swap:           { dropdownVerb:'swap positions with someone else', restingVerb:'swap positions with someone else (X\u2192Y while they go Y\u2192X)', reachableFrom:{person:['noone']} },
  staggeredStart: { dropdownVerb:'start a position on a repeating cadence', restingVerb:'start', reachableFrom:{person:['specific','someone']} },
  allowance:      { dropdownVerb:'have unfilled time', restingVerb:'have', reachableFrom:{person:['specific','everyone','noone']} },
  positionWindow: { dropdownVerb:'only run in a certain time window', restingVerb:'only run', reachableFrom:{position:['specific','any']} },
};
function reachablePredicates(subject){
  if(!subject) return [];
  const out = [];
  for(const id in PREDICATE_DEFS){
    const whoList = PREDICATE_DEFS[id].reachableFrom[subject.kind];
    if(!whoList) continue;
    const current = subject.kind==='person' ? subject.who : subject.which;
    if(whoList.includes(current)) out.push(id);
  }
  return out;
}
function predicateModals(predicateId, subject){
  if(predicateId==='limit' || predicateId==='crossSchedule' || predicateId==='swap') return ['cant','shouldnt'];
  if(predicateId==='staggeredStart') return ['must','should'];
  if(subject.kind==='person' && subject.who==='noone') return ['cant','shouldnt'];
  if(subject.kind==='person' && subject.who==='someone') return ['must','should'];
  return ['must','cant','should','shouldnt'];
}
var SUBJECT_OPTIONS = [
  {value:'person:specific', label:'a specific person'},
  {value:'person:someone', label:'someone'},
  {value:'person:everyone', label:'everyone'},
  {value:'person:noone', label:'no one'},
  {value:'position:specific', label:'a specific position'},
  {value:'position:any', label:'positions tagged\u2026'},
];
function subjectCurrentValue(subject){
  if(!subject) return null;
  return subject.kind==='person' ? 'person:'+subject.who : 'position:'+subject.which;
}
function isSubjectResolved(subject){
  if(!subject) return false;
  if(subject.kind==='person') return subject.who!=='specific' || !!subject.specificId;
  if(subject.which==='specific') return !!subject.specificId;
  return (subject.tagFilter.required||[]).length>0; // "positions tagged\u2026" needs at least one tag to mean anything
}
function blankTarget(){ return {primary:'specific', specificId:null, tagFilter:{required:[],prohibited:[]}, count:{min:1,max:1}}; }

/* rule person/position field <-> subject draft */
function fieldToSubjectDraft(field, effect, allowedWho){
  const base = fieldToTargetDraft(field, 'person', effect);
  let who = base.primary;
  if(who==='any') who = effect==='forbid' ? 'noone' : 'everyone';
  if(!allowedWho.includes(who)) return null;
  return { kind:'person', who, specificId: base.specificId, tagFilter: base.tagFilter, count: base.count };
}
function subjectToPersonField(subj){
  if(subj.who==='specific') return { mode:'id', value:subj.specificId };
  const field = { mode:'any' };
  if((subj.tagFilter.required||[]).length) field.requiredTags = subj.tagFilter.required.slice();
  if((subj.tagFilter.prohibited||[]).length) field.prohibitedTags = subj.tagFilter.prohibited.slice();
  if(subj.who==='someone') field.count = { min:subj.count.min, max:subj.count.max };
  if(subj.who==='everyone') field.count = { min:Math.max(1,state.people.length), max:Math.max(1,state.people.length) };
  return field;
}
function subjectToPositionField(subj){
  if(subj.which==='specific') return { mode:'id', value:subj.specificId };
  const field = { mode:'any' };
  if((subj.tagFilter.required||[]).length) field.requiredTags = subj.tagFilter.required.slice();
  if((subj.tagFilter.prohibited||[]).length) field.prohibitedTags = subj.tagFilter.prohibited.slice();
  return field;
}

/* ---- Detecting / reconstructing a draft from an existing rule (for editing).
   Always fully resolved immediately — the step-by-step reveal is a creation-time
   aid, not something an already-complete rule should be forced back through. ---- */
function detectPredicateFromRule(rule){
  if(rule.kind==='unfilledAllowance') return 'allowance';
  if(rule.kind==='relative'){
    const t = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
    if(t==='together') return 'together';
    if(t==='sequence') return 'sequence';
    if(t==='consecutive' || t==='totalLimit') return 'limit';
    if(t==='crossSchedule') return 'crossSchedule';
    if(t==='swap') return 'swap';
    if(t==='staggeredStart') return 'staggeredStart';
    return null;
  }
  if(!rule.kind || rule.kind==='standard') return 'assignment';
  return null;
}
function blankDraft(predicateId){
  return { subject:null, predicate:predicateId||null, modal:null,
    position:null, time:null, personB:null, positionA:null, positionB:null,
    order:null, maxGap:null, amount:null, unit:null, scope:null, maxRepeat:null, interval:null, minutes:null };
}
function initDraftFromRule(rule){
  const predicateId = detectPredicateFromRule(rule);
  if(!predicateId) return null;
  const draft = blankDraft(predicateId);
  if(predicateId==='allowance'){
    draft.subject = fieldToSubjectDraft(rule.person, rule.effect, ['specific','everyone','noone']);
    if(!draft.subject) return null;
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, rule.effect);
    draft.minutes = rule.minutes; draft.scope = rule.scope||'perInstance';
    return draft;
  }
  if(predicateId==='swap'){
    draft.subject = { kind:'person', who:'noone', specificId:null, tagFilter:{required:[],prohibited:[]}, count:{min:1,max:1} };
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, 'forbid');
    return draft;
  }
  if(predicateId==='assignment'){
    draft.subject = fieldToSubjectDraft(rule.person, rule.effect, ['specific','someone','everyone','noone']);
    if(!draft.subject) return null;
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, rule.effect);
    draft.position = fieldToTargetDraft(rule.position, 'position');
    draft.time = fieldToTimeDraft(rule.slot);
    return draft;
  }
  if(predicateId==='together'){
    draft.subject = fieldToSubjectDraft(rule.person, rule.effect, ['specific','noone']);
    if(!draft.subject) return null;
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, rule.effect);
    draft.personB = fieldToTargetDraft(rule.relative.otherPerson, 'person');
    return draft;
  }
  if(predicateId==='sequence'){
    draft.subject = fieldToSubjectDraft(rule.person, rule.effect, ['specific','noone']);
    if(!draft.subject) return null;
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, rule.effect);
    draft.positionA = fieldToTargetDraft(rule.position, 'position');
    draft.positionB = fieldToTargetDraft(rule.relative.otherPosition, 'position');
    draft.order = rule.relative.order || 'after';
    draft.maxGap = (rule.relative.maxGapMinutes===undefined ? null : rule.relative.maxGapMinutes);
    return draft;
  }
  if(predicateId==='limit'){
    draft.subject = fieldToSubjectDraft(rule.person, rule.effect, ['specific','noone']);
    if(!draft.subject) return null;
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, rule.effect);
    draft.position = fieldToTargetDraft(rule.position, 'position');
    const isConsec = rule.relative.type==='consecutive';
    draft.scope = isConsec ? 'perInstance' : 'total';
    draft.unit = rule.relative.measure==='minutes' ? 'minutes' : 'count';
    draft.amount = isConsec ? (draft.unit==='minutes'?rule.relative.maxConsecutiveMinutes:rule.relative.maxConsecutive) : rule.relative.max;
    return draft;
  }
  if(predicateId==='crossSchedule'){
    draft.subject = fieldToSubjectDraft(rule.person, rule.effect, ['specific','noone']);
    if(!draft.subject) return null;
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, rule.effect);
    draft.maxRepeat = rule.relative.maxRepeat;
    return draft;
  }
  if(predicateId==='staggeredStart'){
    draft.subject = fieldToSubjectDraft(rule.person, rule.effect, ['specific','someone']);
    if(!draft.subject) return null;
    draft.modal = strengthEffectToModal(rule.strength, rule.effect);
    draft.position = fieldToTargetDraft(rule.position, 'position');
    draft.interval = rule.relative.intervalMinutes;
    draft.time = fieldToTimeDraft(rule.slot);
    return draft;
  }
  return null;
}

/* ---- Per-predicate remaining field steps. Each step knows how to render its own
   bubble and whether it currently has a usable value; the sentence stops revealing
   further steps the moment it reaches one that doesn't yet. ---- */
function getPredicateSteps(draft){
  const mkPositionStep = (key, prefixText, labels)=>({
    ensureInit(){ if(!draft[key]) draft[key] = blankTarget(); },
    render(c,r){ if(prefixText) c.appendChild(staticTextEl(prefixText)); renderTargetBubble(c, draft[key], {kind:'position', primaryOptions:['specific','any'], labels: labels||{specific:'a specific position', any:'any position'}, tagCategory:'position'}, r); },
    isComplete(){ return !!draft[key] && (draft[key].primary!=='specific' || !!draft[key].specificId); },
  });
  const mkPersonStep = (key, prefixText, labels)=>({
    ensureInit(){ if(!draft[key]) draft[key] = blankTarget(); },
    render(c,r){ if(prefixText) c.appendChild(staticTextEl(prefixText)); renderTargetBubble(c, draft[key], {kind:'person', primaryOptions:['specific','any'], labels: labels||{specific:'a specific person', any:'anyone'}, tagCategory:'person'}, r); },
    isComplete(){ return !!draft[key] && (draft[key].primary!=='specific' || !!draft[key].specificId); },
  });
  const mkTimeStep = (opts)=>({
    ensureInit(){ if(!draft.time) draft.time = { kind:(opts&&opts.defaultKind)||'any', slotIndex:0, start:0, end:Math.max(0,getSlots().length-1) }; },
    render(c,r){ renderTimeBubble(c, draft.time, r, opts); },
    isComplete(){ return true; },
  });
  const mkNumberStep = (key, opts)=>({
    ensureInit(){ if(draft[key]===null || draft[key]===undefined) draft[key] = (opts.default===undefined?null:opts.default); },
    render(c,r){
      if(opts.prefix) c.appendChild(staticTextEl(opts.prefix));
      const inp = document.createElement('input');
      inp.type = 'number'; inp.className = 'db-bubble-input narrow';
      if(opts.min!==undefined) inp.min = opts.min;
      if(opts.step!==undefined) inp.step = opts.step;
      if(opts.placeholder) inp.placeholder = opts.placeholder;
      inp.value = (draft[key]===null || draft[key]===undefined) ? '' : draft[key];
      inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
        draft[key] = (inp.value==='' && opts.allowEmpty) ? null : (Number(inp.value)||opts.default);
        r();
      });
      const { el } = bubbleEl(null, null, {contentEl:inp});
      c.appendChild(el);
      if(opts.suffix) c.appendChild(staticTextEl(opts.suffix));
    },
    isComplete(){ return true; },
  });
  const mkChoiceStep = (key, initial, options, render1st)=>({
    ensureInit(){ if(!draft[key]) draft[key] = initial; },
    render(c,r){
      const current = options.find(o=>o.value===draft[key]) || options[0];
      const { el } = bubbleEl(current.label, (arrowEl)=>{
        openBubbleMenu(arrowEl, options, draft[key], (v)=>{ if(render1st) render1st(v); draft[key]=v; r(); });
      });
      c.appendChild(el);
    },
    isComplete(){ return true; },
  });

  switch(draft.predicate){
    case 'assignment': return [ mkPositionStep('position','for'), mkTimeStep() ];
    case 'together': return [ mkPersonStep('personB', null) ];
    case 'sequence': return [
      mkPositionStep('positionB', null),
      mkChoiceStep('order', 'after', [{value:'after',label:'right after'},{value:'before',label:'right before'},{value:'either',label:'within'}]),
      mkPositionStep('positionA', 'doing'),
      { applicable(){ return draft.order==='either'; },
        ensureInit(){ if(draft.maxGap===undefined) draft.maxGap = null; },
        render(c,r){ mkNumberStep('maxGap', {min:0, step:5, default:null, placeholder:'any gap', allowEmpty:true, suffix:'minutes'}).render(c,r); },
        isComplete(){ return true; } },
    ];
    case 'limit': return [
      mkNumberStep('amount', {prefix:'more than', min: draft.unit==='minutes'?SLOT_MINUTES:1, step: draft.unit==='minutes'?SLOT_MINUTES:1, default:2}),
      mkChoiceStep('unit', 'count', [{value:'count',label:'slots'},{value:'minutes',label:'minutes'}], (v)=>{ if(v!==draft.unit) draft.amount = v==='minutes'?30:2; }),
      mkPositionStep('position', 'of'),
      mkChoiceStep('scope', 'perInstance', [{value:'perInstance',label:'at a time'},{value:'total',label:'throughout the day'}]),
    ];
    case 'crossSchedule': return [
      mkNumberStep('maxRepeat', {prefix:'the same assignment for more than', min:2, step:1, default:2, suffix:'schedules in a row'}),
    ];
    case 'staggeredStart': return [
      mkPositionStep('position', null),
      mkNumberStep('interval', {prefix:'every', min:SLOT_MINUTES, step:SLOT_MINUTES, default:15, suffix:'minutes'}),
      mkTimeStep(),
    ];
    case 'allowance': return [
      mkNumberStep('minutes', {min:0, step:SLOT_MINUTES, default:15, suffix:'minutes of unfilled time,'}),
      mkChoiceStep('scope', 'perInstance', [{value:'perInstance',label:'at a time'},{value:'total',label:'throughout the whole day'}]),
    ];
    case 'positionWindow': return [ mkTimeStep({defaultKind:'range', anyLabel:'at any time (no restriction)'}) ];
    case 'swap': return [];
    default: return [];
  }
}

function buildRuleFromDraft(draft){
  if(!draft.subject || !isSubjectResolved(draft.subject) || !draft.predicate || !draft.modal) return null;
  for(const step of getPredicateSteps(draft)){
    if(step.applicable && !step.applicable()) continue;
    if(!step.isComplete()) return null;
  }
  const { strength, effect } = modalToStrengthEffect(draft.modal);
  const subj = draft.subject;
  switch(draft.predicate){
    case 'allowance': return { kind:'unfilledAllowance', strength, effect, person: subjectToPersonField(subj), minutes: Math.max(0,Number(draft.minutes)||0), scope: draft.scope||'perInstance' };
