```{=html}
    case 'swap': return { kind:'relative', strength, effect:'forbid', person:{mode:'any'}, position:{mode:'any'}, slot:{mode:'any'}, relative:{type:'swap'} };
    case 'assignment': return { kind:'standard', strength, effect, person: subjectToPersonField(subj), position: targetDraftToField(draft.position,'position'), slot: timeDraftToField(draft.time) };
    case 'together': return { kind:'relative', strength, effect, person: subjectToPersonField(subj), position:{mode:'any'}, slot:{mode:'any'}, relative:{type:'together', otherPerson: targetDraftToField(draft.personB,'person')} };
    case 'sequence': return { kind:'relative', strength, effect, person: subjectToPersonField(subj), position: targetDraftToField(draft.positionA,'position'), slot:{mode:'any'},
      relative:{ type:'sequence', order:draft.order, otherPosition: targetDraftToField(draft.positionB,'position'), maxGapMinutes: draft.maxGap } };
    case 'limit': {
      const relType = draft.scope==='total' ? 'totalLimit' : 'consecutive';
      const relative = { type: relType, measure: draft.unit };
      if(relType==='consecutive'){
        if(draft.unit==='minutes') relative.maxConsecutiveMinutes = Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Number(draft.amount)||SLOT_MINUTES);
        else relative.maxConsecutive = Math.max(2, Number(draft.amount)||2);
      } else {
        relative.max = Math.max(draft.unit==='minutes'?SLOT_MINUTES:1, Number(draft.amount)||(draft.unit==='minutes'?SLOT_MINUTES:1));
      }
      return { kind:'relative', strength, effect, person: subjectToPersonField(subj), position: targetDraftToField(draft.position,'position'), slot:{mode:'any'}, relative };
    }
    case 'crossSchedule': return { kind:'relative', strength, effect, person: subjectToPersonField(subj), position:{mode:'any'}, slot:{mode:'any'}, relative:{type:'crossSchedule', maxRepeat: Math.max(2, Number(draft.maxRepeat)||2)} };
    case 'staggeredStart': return { kind:'relative', strength, effect, person: subjectToPersonField(subj), position: targetDraftToField(draft.position,'position'), slot: timeDraftToField(draft.time), relative:{type:'staggeredStart', intervalMinutes: Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Number(draft.interval)||15)} };
    case 'positionWindow': return { kind:'standard', strength, effect, person:{mode:'any'}, position: subjectToPositionField(subj), slot: timeDraftToField(draft.time) };
    default: return null;
  }
}

/* ---- Bubble 1 (subject) ---- */
function renderSubjectBubble(container, draft, rerender){
  const subject = draft.subject;
  const isUnset = !subject;
  let mainLabel;
  if(!subject) mainLabel = 'choose who or what';
  else if(subject.kind==='person'){
    if(subject.who==='specific') mainLabel = subject.specificId ? personName(subject.specificId) : 'choose a person';
    else mainLabel = {someone:'someone', everyone:'everyone', noone:'no one'}[subject.who];
  } else {
    if(subject.which==='specific') mainLabel = subject.specificId ? positionName(subject.specificId) : 'choose a position';
    else mainLabel = 'positions ' + (tagComboPhrase(subject.tagFilter.required, subject.tagFilter.prohibited) || '\u2026');
  }
  const { el } = bubbleEl(mainLabel, (arrowEl)=>{
    openBubbleMenu(arrowEl, SUBJECT_OPTIONS, subjectCurrentValue(subject), (val)=>{
      const [kind, sub] = val.split(':');
      if(kind==='person') draft.subject = { kind:'person', who:sub, specificId:null, tagFilter:{required:[],prohibited:[]}, count:{min:1,max:1} };
      else draft.subject = { kind:'position', which:sub, specificId:null, tagFilter:{required:[],prohibited:[]} };
      draft.predicate = null; draft.modal = null;
      ['position','time','personB','positionA','positionB','order','maxGap','amount','unit','scope','maxRepeat','interval','minutes'].forEach(k=>{ draft[k]=null; });
      rerender();
      if(kind==='position' && sub==='any'){
        const freshBubble = document.querySelector('.db-sentence .db-bubble');
        const tags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='position');
        if(freshBubble && tags.length){
          openBubbleMenu(freshBubble, tags.map(t=>({value:t.id,label:t.name})), null, (tv)=>{ draft.subject.tagFilter.required=[tv]; rerender(); });
        }
      }
    });
  }, { unset:isUnset });
  el.style.cursor = 'pointer';
  el.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.target.classList.contains('db-bubble-arrow') || !subject) return;
    if(subject.kind==='person' && subject.who==='specific'){
      openBubbleMenu(el, state.people.map(p=>({value:p.id,label:p.name})), subject.specificId, (v)=>{ subject.specificId=v; rerender(); }, {searchable:true});
    } else if(subject.kind==='position' && subject.which==='specific'){
      openBubbleMenu(el, state.positions.map(p=>({value:p.id,label:p.name})), subject.specificId, (v)=>{ subject.specificId=v; rerender(); }, {searchable:true});
    }
  });
  container.appendChild(el);
  if(subject && subject.kind==='person' && subject.who==='someone'){
    const total = Math.max(1,state.people.length);
    const cl = (subject.count.min===subject.count.max) ? `${subject.count.min} ${subject.count.min===1?'person':'people'}` : `${subject.count.min}\u2013${subject.count.max} people`;
    const { el: countBubble } = bubbleEl(`for ${cl}`, (arrowEl)=>openCountEditor(arrowEl, subject.count, total, rerender));
    container.appendChild(countBubble);
  }
  if(subject && subject.kind==='person' && subject.who!=='specific'){
    renderTagComboFollowup(container, subject.tagFilter, 'person', rerender);
  }
  if(subject && subject.kind==='position' && subject.which==='any'){
    renderTagComboFollowup(container, subject.tagFilter, 'position', rerender);
  }
}

/* ---- Bubble 2 (predicate + modal, combined into one list of full verb phrases) ---- */
function renderPredicateBubble(container, draft, rerender){
  const subject = draft.subject;
  const isNegative = subject.kind==='person' && subject.who==='noone';
  const options = [];
  reachablePredicates(subject).forEach(id=>{
    predicateModals(id, subject).forEach(modal=>{
      options.push({ value: id+'|'+modal, label: `${modalWord(modal, isNegative)} ${PREDICATE_DEFS[id].dropdownVerb}` });
    });
  });
  const isUnset = !draft.predicate;
  const mainLabel = draft.predicate ? `${modalWord(draft.modal, isNegative)} ${PREDICATE_DEFS[draft.predicate].restingVerb}` : 'choose what happens';
  const { el } = bubbleEl(mainLabel, (arrowEl)=>{
    openBubbleMenu(arrowEl, options, draft.predicate ? draft.predicate+'|'+draft.modal : null, (val)=>{
      const [predicateId, modal] = val.split('|');
      if(draft.predicate!==predicateId){
        ['position','time','personB','positionA','positionB','order','maxGap','amount','unit','scope','maxRepeat','interval','minutes'].forEach(k=>{ draft[k]=null; });
      }
      draft.predicate = predicateId; draft.modal = modal;
      rerender();
    }, {searchable:true});
  }, { unset:isUnset });
  container.appendChild(el);
}

/* ---- "Make Exclusive" — only for the assignment predicate's require side. ---- */
function ruleShapeKey(r){ return JSON.stringify({ kind:r.kind||'standard', person:r.person, position:r.position, slot:r.slot, effect:r.effect }); }
function findExistingMatchingRule(candidateRuleFields){
  const key = ruleShapeKey(candidateRuleFields);
  return state.rules.find(r=>ruleShapeKey(r)===key);
}
function computeExclusiveCandidates(predicateId, built){
  if(predicateId!=='assignment' || !built || built.effect!=='require') return [];
  const candidates = [];
  if(built.slot.mode==='id' || built.slot.mode==='range'){
    const exceptSlot = built.slot.mode==='id' ? {mode:'except', value:built.slot.value} : {mode:'exceptRange', start:built.slot.start, end:built.slot.end};
    const timePhrase = slotDescription(built.slot).replace(/^at |^from /,'');
    candidates.push({ key:'notOtherTime',
      description: `${cap(targetDescription(built.person,'person'))} must not be at ${targetDescription(built.position,'position')} other than (an assignment at) ${timePhrase}`,
      rule: { kind:'standard', strength:built.strength, effect:'forbid', person: built.person, position: built.position, slot: exceptSlot, tags:[] } });
  }
  if(built.person.mode==='id'){
    candidates.push({ key:'noOneElse',
      description: `No one except ${personName(built.person.value)} can be at ${targetDescription(built.position,'position')} ${slotDescription(built.slot)}`,
      rule: { kind:'standard', strength:built.strength, effect:'forbid', person:{mode:'except', value:built.person.value}, position: built.position, slot: built.slot, tags:[] } });
  }
  return candidates;
}

var sbExclusiveSelections = {};
var sbOnlyDisableDeselected = false;

function renderSentenceBuilder(editing){
  const root = document.getElementById('sentence-builder-root');
  if(!root) return;
  let draft = editing ? initDraftFromRule(editing) : blankDraft(null);
  if(editing && !draft) draft = blankDraft(null); // couldn't represent it — manual-rule-details will be forced open instead
  sbExclusiveSelections = {}; sbOnlyDisableDeselected = false;

  function renderExclusiveSection(built){
    if(!draft.predicate || draft.predicate!=='assignment' || !built || built.effect!=='require') return;
    const candidates = computeExclusiveCandidates(draft.predicate, built).filter(c=>{
      const existing = findExistingMatchingRule(c.rule);
      return !(editing && existing && existing.id===editing.id);
    });
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.style.marginTop = '16px';
    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.style.fontWeight = '600'; title.style.fontSize = '12.5px'; title.style.marginBottom = '6px';
    title.textContent = 'Make Exclusive:';
    wrap.appendChild(title);
    if(candidates.length===0){
      const none = document.createElement('div');
      none.className = 'db-empty-note'; none.style.padding = '0';
      none.textContent = 'No exclusive companion rules apply to this rule.';
      wrap.appendChild(none);
      root.appendChild(wrap);
      return;
    }
    let anyExisting = false;
    candidates.forEach(c=>{
      const existingRule = findExistingMatchingRule(c.rule);
      if(existingRule) anyExisting = true;
      if(!(c.key in sbExclusiveSelections)) sbExclusiveSelections[c.key] = !!existingRule;
      const checked = sbExclusiveSelections[c.key];
      const markedForRemoval = !!(existingRule && !checked);
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'db-exclusive-row' + (markedForRemoval ? ' marked-remove' : '');
      const cb = document.createElement('input');
      cb.type = 'checkbox'; cb.checked = checked;
      cb.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ sbExclusiveSelections[c.key] = cb.checked; rerender(); });
      row.appendChild(cb);
      const label = document.createElement('label');
      if(existingRule){ const star=document.createElement('span'); star.className='db-exclusive-mark'; star.textContent='*'; label.appendChild(star); }
      if(markedForRemoval){ const redX=document.createElement('span'); redX.style.color='var(--danger)'; redX.style.fontWeight='700'; redX.style.marginRight='4px'; redX.textContent='✕'; label.appendChild(redX); }
      label.appendChild(document.createTextNode(c.description + '.'));
      row.appendChild(label);
      wrap.appendChild(row);
    });
    if(anyExisting){
      const note = document.createElement('div');
      note.className = 'db-help-text'; note.style.marginTop = '6px';
      note.textContent = '*this rule already exists, select to remove it instead.';
      wrap.appendChild(note);
      const toggleRow = document.createElement('div');
      toggleRow.className = 'db-field checkbox'; toggleRow.style.marginTop = '8px';
      const toggleCb = document.createElement('input');
      toggleCb.type = 'checkbox'; toggleCb.id = 'sb-only-disable-toggle'; toggleCb.checked = sbOnlyDisableDeselected;
      toggleCb.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ sbOnlyDisableDeselected = toggleCb.checked; });
      toggleRow.appendChild(toggleCb);
      const toggleLabel = document.createElement('label');
      toggleLabel.setAttribute('for','sb-only-disable-toggle');
      toggleLabel.textContent = 'Only disable deselected rules';
      toggleRow.appendChild(toggleLabel);
      wrap.appendChild(toggleRow);
    }
    root.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  function rerender(){
    root.innerHTML = '';
    const helpRow = document.createElement('div');
    helpRow.style.display='flex'; helpRow.style.justifyContent='space-between'; helpRow.style.alignItems='flex-start'; helpRow.style.gap='8px';
    const help = document.createElement('div');
    help.className = 'db-help-text';
    help.textContent = 'Click any part of the sentence to change it, or its arrow to pick something else entirely. The ? icon has examples.';
    helpRow.appendChild(help);
    const qIcon = document.createElement('span');
    qIcon.className = 'db-info-icon'; qIcon.tabIndex = 0; qIcon.style.flexShrink = '0';
    qIcon.innerHTML = '?<span class="db-info-tooltip">Build a rule as a sentence: the first bubble is who or what the rule is about, the next is what happens, and the rest fill themselves in from there. Examples: "Someone must be scheduled for Front Desk, from 10:30 AM to 12:00 PM." \u00b7 "No one can be scheduled for positions tagged \u2018Physically demanding\u2019 for more than 2 slots at a time." \u00b7 "Allow Alice to have 30 minutes of unfilled time, throughout the whole day."</span>';
    helpRow.appendChild(qIcon);
    root.appendChild(helpRow);

    const sentence = document.createElement('div');
    sentence.className = 'db-sentence';
    renderSubjectBubble(sentence, draft, rerender);
    let built = null;
    if(isSubjectResolved(draft.subject)){
      renderPredicateBubble(sentence, draft, rerender);
      if(draft.predicate){
        for(const step of getPredicateSteps(draft)){
          if(step.applicable && !step.applicable()) continue;
          step.ensureInit();
          step.render(sentence, rerender);
          if(!step.isComplete()) break;
        }
        built = buildRuleFromDraft(draft);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(sentence);

    const preview = document.createElement('div');
    preview.className = 'db-sentence-preview';
    preview.textContent = built ? ruleLabel(built) : 'Keep choosing to complete this rule.';
    root.appendChild(preview);

    renderExclusiveSection(built);

    const actionsRow = document.createElement('div');
    actionsRow.className = 'row'; actionsRow.style.marginTop = '12px';
    const submitBtn = document.createElement('button');
    submitBtn.className = 'btn btn-primary';
    submitBtn.textContent = editing ? 'Update rule' : 'Add rule';
    submitBtn.disabled = !built;
    submitBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>submitSentenceRule(draft, built, editing));
    actionsRow.appendChild(submitBtn);
    if(editing){
      const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
      cancelBtn.className = 'btn'; cancelBtn.textContent = 'Cancel';
      cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ editingRuleId = null; renderRulesTab(); });
      actionsRow.appendChild(cancelBtn);
    }
    root.appendChild(actionsRow);
  }
  rerender();
}

function submitSentenceRule(draft, built, editing){
  if(!built) return;
  pushUndoSnapshot();
  if(editing){
    const idx = state.rules.findIndex(r=>r.id===editing.id);
    if(idx>=0) state.rules[idx] = { ...editing, ...built };
  } else {
    state.rules.push({ id:genId('rule'), active:true, nickname:'', tags:[], ...built });
  }
  if(draft.predicate==='assignment' && built.effect==='require'){
    computeExclusiveCandidates(draft.predicate, built).forEach(c=>{
      const existingRule = findExistingMatchingRule(c.rule);
      if(editing && existingRule && existingRule.id===editing.id) return;
      const checked = !!sbExclusiveSelections[c.key];
      if(!existingRule && checked){
        state.rules.push({ id:genId('rule'), active:true, nickname:'', tags:[], ...c.rule });
      } else if(existingRule && !checked){
        if(sbOnlyDisableDeselected) existingRule.active = false;
        else state.rules = state.rules.filter(r=>r.id!==existingRule.id);
      }
    });
  }
  const wasEditing = !!editing;
  editingRuleId = null;
  sbExclusiveSelections = {}; sbOnlyDisableDeselected = false;
  if(wasEditing) closeSettings(); else renderRulesTab();
  renderAll();
}

      <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:12px;">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" id="rb-submit">${editing ? 'Update rule' : 'Add rule'}</button>

    <table class="db-mini-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Rule</th><th>Strength</th><th>Active</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="rules-tbody"></tbody>
    </table>`;

  const personModeSel = document.getElementById('rb-person-mode');
  const positionModeSel = document.getElementById('rb-position-mode');
  const slotModeSel = document.getElementById('rb-slot-mode');
  const personValueSel = document.getElementById('rb-person-value');
  const positionValueSel = document.getElementById('rb-position-value');
  const slotValueSel = document.getElementById('rb-slot-value');
  const slotEndSel = document.getElementById('rb-slot-end');
  const kindSel = document.getElementById('rb-kind');
  const relTypeSel = document.getElementById('rb-relative-type');
  const slots = getSlots();

  function fillPersonValueOptions(mode){
    if(mode==='id') personValueSel.innerHTML = state.people.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else if(mode==='tag') personValueSel.innerHTML = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='person').map(t=>`<option value="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else personValueSel.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('rb-person-value-wrap').style.display = mode==='any' ? 'none' : 'flex';
    updateAnyoneFieldsVisibility();
  }
  function updateAnyoneFieldsVisibility(){
    const isAnyone = personModeSel.value==='any';
    document.getElementById('rb-anyone-fields').style.display = isAnyone ? 'flex' : 'none';
    const effectSel = document.getElementById('rb-effect');
    document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-wrap').style.display = (isAnyone && effectSel && effectSel.value==='require') ? 'flex' : 'none';
    updateAllPeopleButtonVisibility();
  }
  function updateAllPeopleButtonVisibility(){
    const btn = document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-all');
    if(!btn) return;
    const total = state.people.length;
    const min = Number(document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-min').value)||0;
    const max = Number(document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-max').value)||0;
    btn.style.display = (total>0 && (min!==total || max!==total)) ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
  }
  function fillPositionValueOptions(mode){
    if(mode==='id') positionValueSel.innerHTML = state.positions.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else if(mode==='tag') positionValueSel.innerHTML = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='position').map(t=>`<option value="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else positionValueSel.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('rb-position-value-wrap').style.display = mode==='any' ? 'none' : 'flex';
  }
  function fillSlotOptions(){
    const opts = slots.map((s,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${s.label}</option>`).join('');
    const endOpts = slots.map((s,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${formatTime(s.minutes+SLOT_MINUTES)}</option>`).join('');
    slotValueSel.innerHTML = opts; slotEndSel.innerHTML = endOpts;
  }
  function updateSlotVisibility(mode){
    document.getElementById('rb-slot-value-wrap').style.display = mode==='any' ? 'none' : 'flex';
    document.getElementById('rb-slot-end-wrap').style.display = mode==='range' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-slot-value-wrap').querySelector('label').textContent = mode==='range' ? 'From' : 'At';
  }
  function fillOtherPositionValueOptions(mode){
    const sel = document.getElementById('rb-seq-other-position-value');
    if(mode==='id') sel.innerHTML = state.positions.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else if(mode==='tag') sel.innerHTML = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='position').map(t=>`<option value="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else sel.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('rb-seq-other-position-value-wrap').style.display = mode==='any' ? 'none' : 'flex';
  }
  function fillOtherPersonValueOptions(mode){
    const sel = document.getElementById('rb-together-other-person-value');
    if(mode==='id') sel.innerHTML = state.people.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else if(mode==='tag') sel.innerHTML = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='person').map(t=>`<option value="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</option>`).join('');
    else sel.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('rb-together-other-person-value-wrap').style.display = mode==='any' ? 'none' : 'flex';
  }
  function updateKindVisibility(){
    const isRelative = kindSel.value==='relative';
    document.getElementById('rb-relative-section').style.display = isRelative ? 'block' : 'none';
    if(isRelative){
      updateRelativeTypeVisibility(); // decides rb-time-row itself — staggeredStart needs it, others don't
    } else {
      document.getElementById('rb-time-row').style.display = 'flex';
    }
  }
  function updateRelativeTypeVisibility(){
    const t = relTypeSel.value;
    document.getElementById('rb-time-row').style.display = (t==='staggeredStart') ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-seq-fields').style.display = t==='sequence' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-together-fields').style.display = t==='together' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-consecutive-fields').style.display = t==='consecutive' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-totallimit-fields').style.display = t==='totalLimit' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-crossschedule-fields').style.display = t==='crossSchedule' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-staggered-fields').style.display = t==='staggeredStart' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    if(t==='consecutive') updateConsecMeasureVisibility();
    if(t==='totalLimit') updateTotalMeasureVisibility();
    const hints = {
      sequence: 'Example: "No one can be at Cafeteria at any time after being at Garbage Duty." Or set Order to "Near" and a max gap for "Position Y should be scheduled within 15 minutes of Position Z."',
      together: 'Example: "Alice should be at the same time and place as Bob." Use Position above to restrict which shared position counts, or leave it as Any.',
      consecutive: 'Example: "No one should have more than 30 minutes of a Physically demanding position in a row." Compares a person\u2019s own back-to-back assignments in this schedule.',
      totalLimit: 'Example: "No one should do Position A more than twice" or "No more than 45 total minutes of Physically demanding positions." Counts across the whole schedule, not just consecutive slots.',
      crossSchedule: 'Example: "Bob shouldn\u2019t have the same assignment for more than two schedules in a row." Compares the same time slot across consecutive schedule tabs, in their current order.',
      swap: 'Example: "No mutual swaps" — nobody can go from position X to position Y while someone else goes from Y to X. Applies across any pair of positions; no extra fields needed.',
      staggeredStart: 'Example: "Someone must start Front Desk every 15 minutes, from 10:30 AM to 4:30 PM." Use the Time field above to set that range (or leave it as Any time for the whole schedule). Works as a Required + "Must be scheduled" rule — currently the only combination this type is checked against.',
    };
    document.getElementById('rb-relative-hint').textContent = hints[t] || '';
  }
  function updateConsecMeasureVisibility(){
    const isMinutes = document.getElementById('rb-consec-measure').value==='minutes';
    document.getElementById('rb-consec-count-wrap').style.display = isMinutes ? 'none' : 'flex';
    document.getElementById('rb-consec-minutes-wrap').style.display = isMinutes ? 'flex' : 'none';
  }
  function updateTotalMeasureVisibility(){
    const isMinutes = document.getElementById('rb-total-measure').value==='minutes';
    document.getElementById('rb-total-count-wrap').style.display = isMinutes ? 'none' : 'flex';
    document.getElementById('rb-total-minutes-wrap').style.display = isMinutes ? 'flex' : 'none';
  }
  fillSlotOptions();

  let selectedRequiredTagIds = new Set(editing && editing.person.mode==='any' ? (editing.person.requiredTags||[]) : []);
  let selectedProhibitedTagIds = new Set(editing && editing.person.mode==='any' ? (editing.person.prohibitedTags||[]) : []);
  function renderAnyoneTagPicker(wrapId, selectedSet){
    const personTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='person');
    const wrap = document.getElementById(wrapId);
    wrap.innerHTML = personTags.map(t=>{
      const on = selectedSet.has(t.id);
      const style = on ? `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};` : '';
      return `<span class="db-chip-toggle ${on?'on':''}" style="${style}" data-tag-id="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span>`;
    }).join('') || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">No person tags yet.</span>';
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.db-chip-toggle').forEach(chipEl=>{
      chipEl.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        const tid = chipEl.dataset.tagId;
        const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===tid);
        if(selectedSet.has(tid)){
          selectedSet.delete(tid); chipEl.classList.remove('on'); chipEl.style.cssText = '';
        } else {
          selectedSet.add(tid); chipEl.classList.add('on');
          chipEl.style.cssText = `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};`;
        }
        updatePreview();
      });
    });
  }

  function buildRuleFromForm(){
    const personMode = personModeSel.value, positionMode = positionModeSel.value;
    const person = personMode==='any' ? {mode:'any'} : {mode:personMode, value:personValueSel.value};
    if(personMode==='any'){
      person.requiredTags = Array.from(selectedRequiredTagIds);
      person.prohibitedTags = Array.from(selectedProhibitedTagIds);
      person.count = {
        min: Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-min').value)||1),
        max: Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-max').value)||1),
      };
      if(person.count.max<person.count.min) person.count.max = person.count.min;
    }
    const position = positionMode==='any' ? {mode:'any'} : {mode:positionMode, value:positionValueSel.value};
    const kind = kindSel.value;
    const relType = kind==='relative' ? relTypeSel.value : null;
    let slot;
    if(kind==='relative' && relType!=='staggeredStart'){
      slot = {mode:'any'};
    } else {
      const slotMode = slotModeSel.value;
      if(slotMode==='any') slot = {mode:'any'};
      else if(slotMode==='id') slot = {mode:'id', value:Number(slotValueSel.value)};
      else {
        let start = Number(slotValueSel.value), end = Number(slotEndSel.value);
        if(end<start){ const t2=start; start=end; end=t2; }
        slot = {mode:'range', start, end};
      }
    }
    let relative = null;
    if(kind==='relative'){
      if(relType==='sequence'){
        const opMode = document.getElementById('rb-seq-other-position-mode').value;
        const orderVal = document.getElementById('rb-seq-order').value;
        const gapRaw = document.getElementById('rb-seq-max-gap').value;
        relative = {
          type:'sequence',
          order: (orderVal==='before'||orderVal==='either') ? orderVal : 'after',
          otherPosition: opMode==='any' ? {mode:'any'} : {mode:opMode, value:document.getElementById('rb-seq-other-position-value').value},
          maxGapMinutes: gapRaw==='' ? null : Math.max(0, Number(gapRaw)||0),
        };
      } else if(relType==='together'){
        const opMode = document.getElementById('rb-together-other-person-mode').value;
        relative = {
          type:'together',
          otherPerson: opMode==='any' ? {mode:'any'} : {mode:opMode, value:document.getElementById('rb-together-other-person-value').value},
        };
      } else if(relType==='consecutive'){
        const measure = document.getElementById('rb-consec-measure').value==='minutes' ? 'minutes' : 'count';
        relative = { type:'consecutive', measure,
          maxConsecutive: Math.max(2, Number(document.getElementById('rb-consec-max').value)||2),
          maxConsecutiveMinutes: Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Number(document.getElementById('rb-consec-max-minutes').value)||30) };
      } else if(relType==='totalLimit'){
        const measure = document.getElementById('rb-total-measure').value==='minutes' ? 'minutes' : 'count';
        relative = { type:'totalLimit', measure,
          max: measure==='minutes'
            ? Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Number(document.getElementById('rb-total-max-minutes').value)||45)
            : Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('rb-total-max').value)||2) };
      } else if(relType==='crossSchedule'){
        relative = { type:'crossSchedule', maxRepeat: Math.max(2, Number(document.getElementById('rb-cross-max').value)||2) };
      } else if(relType==='staggeredStart'){
        relative = { type:'staggeredStart', intervalMinutes: Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Number(document.getElementById('rb-staggered-interval').value)||15) };
      } else {
        relative = { type:'swap' };
      }
    }
    return {
      kind,
      nickname: document.getElementById('rb-nickname').value.trim(),
      strength: document.getElementById('rb-strength').value,
      effect: document.getElementById('rb-effect').value,
      active: document.getElementById('rb-active').checked,
      person, position, slot, relative,
      tags: Array.from(selectedRuleTagIds),
    };
  }
  function updatePreview(){
    updateAllPeopleButtonVisibility();
    document.getElementById('rb-preview').textContent = ruleLabel(buildRuleFromForm());
  }
  function renderTagChips(){
    const ruleTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='rule');
    const wrap = document.getElementById('rb-tags-chips');
    wrap.innerHTML = ruleTags.map(t=>{
      const on = selectedRuleTagIds.has(t.id);
      const style = on ? `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};` : '';
      return `<span class="db-chip-toggle ${on?'on':''}" style="${style}" data-tag-id="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span>`;
    }).join('') || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">No rule tags yet — add some in the Tags tab.</span>';
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.db-chip-toggle').forEach(chipEl=>{
      chipEl.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        const tid = chipEl.dataset.tagId;
        const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===tid);
        if(selectedRuleTagIds.has(tid)){
          selectedRuleTagIds.delete(tid);
          chipEl.classList.remove('on');
          chipEl.style.cssText = '';
        } else {
          selectedRuleTagIds.add(tid);
          chipEl.classList.add('on');
          chipEl.style.cssText = `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};`;
        }
        updatePreview();
      });
    });
  }

  personModeSel.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ fillPersonValueOptions(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  positionModeSel.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ fillPositionValueOptions(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  slotModeSel.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ updateSlotVisibility(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  kindSel.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ updateKindVisibility(); updatePreview(); });
  relTypeSel.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ updateRelativeTypeVisibility(); updatePreview(); });
  document.getElementById('rb-effect').addEventListener('change', ()=>{ updateAnyoneFieldsVisibility(); updatePreview(); });
  document.getElementById('rb-seq-other-position-mode').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ fillOtherPositionValueOptions(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  document.getElementById('rb-together-other-person-mode').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ fillOtherPersonValueOptions(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  document.getElementById('rb-consec-measure').addEventListener('change', ()=>{ updateConsecMeasureVisibility(); updatePreview(); });
  document.getElementById('rb-total-measure').addEventListener('change', ()=>{ updateTotalMeasureVisibility(); updatePreview(); });
  ['rb-strength','rb-person-value','rb-position-value','rb-slot-value','rb-slot-end','rb-active',
   'rb-seq-order','rb-seq-other-position-value','rb-seq-max-gap','rb-together-other-person-value',
   'rb-consec-max','rb-consec-max-minutes','rb-total-max','rb-total-max-minutes','rb-cross-max',
   'rb-staggered-interval','rb-anyone-count-min','rb-anyone-count-max'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.addEventListener('change', updatePreview);
    el.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);
  });
  document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-all').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const total = state.people.length;
    document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-min').value = total;
    document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-max').value = total;
    updatePreview();
  });
  document.getElementById('rb-required-tags-link').addEventListener('click', ()=>jumpToTags('person'));
  document.getElementById('rb-prohibited-tags-link').addEventListener('click', ()=>jumpToTags('person'));

  if(editing){
    document.getElementById('rb-nickname').value = editing.nickname || '';
    document.getElementById('rb-strength').value = editing.strength;
    document.getElementById('rb-effect').value = editing.effect;
    document.getElementById('rb-active').checked = editing.active;
    personModeSel.value = editing.person.mode;
    fillPersonValueOptions(editing.person.mode);
    if(editing.person.mode!=='any') personValueSel.value = editing.person.value;
    if(editing.person.mode==='any' && editing.person.count){
      document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-min').value = editing.person.count.min;
      document.getElementById('rb-anyone-count-max').value = editing.person.count.max;
    }
    positionModeSel.value = editing.position.mode;
    fillPositionValueOptions(editing.position.mode);
    if(editing.position.mode!=='any') positionValueSel.value = editing.position.value;
    slotModeSel.value = editing.slot.mode;
    updateSlotVisibility(editing.slot.mode);
    if(editing.slot.mode==='id') slotValueSel.value = editing.slot.value;
    if(editing.slot.mode==='range'){ slotValueSel.value = editing.slot.start; slotEndSel.value = editing.slot.end; }

    kindSel.value = editing.kind || 'standard';
    updateKindVisibility();
    fillOtherPositionValueOptions('any');
    fillOtherPersonValueOptions('any');
    if(editing.kind==='relative' && editing.relative){
      relTypeSel.value = editing.relative.type;
      updateRelativeTypeVisibility();
      if(editing.relative.type==='sequence'){
        document.getElementById('rb-seq-order').value = editing.relative.order||'after';
        const m = editing.relative.otherPosition ? editing.relative.otherPosition.mode : 'any';
        document.getElementById('rb-seq-other-position-mode').value = m;
        fillOtherPositionValueOptions(m);
        if(m!=='any') document.getElementById('rb-seq-other-position-value').value = editing.relative.otherPosition.value;
        document.getElementById('rb-seq-max-gap').value = (editing.relative.maxGapMinutes!==undefined && editing.relative.maxGapMinutes!==null) ? editing.relative.maxGapMinutes : '';
      } else if(editing.relative.type==='together'){
        const m = editing.relative.otherPerson ? editing.relative.otherPerson.mode : 'any';
        document.getElementById('rb-together-other-person-mode').value = m;
        fillOtherPersonValueOptions(m);
        if(m!=='any') document.getElementById('rb-together-other-person-value').value = editing.relative.otherPerson.value;
      } else if(editing.relative.type==='consecutive'){
        document.getElementById('rb-consec-measure').value = editing.relative.measure==='minutes' ? 'minutes' : 'count';
        document.getElementById('rb-consec-max').value = editing.relative.maxConsecutive || 2;
        document.getElementById('rb-consec-max-minutes').value = editing.relative.maxConsecutiveMinutes || 30;
        updateConsecMeasureVisibility();
      } else if(editing.relative.type==='totalLimit'){
        document.getElementById('rb-total-measure').value = editing.relative.measure==='minutes' ? 'minutes' : 'count';
        document.getElementById('rb-total-max').value = editing.relative.measure==='minutes' ? 2 : (editing.relative.max || 2);
        document.getElementById('rb-total-max-minutes').value = editing.relative.measure==='minutes' ? (editing.relative.max || 45) : 45;
        updateTotalMeasureVisibility();
      } else if(editing.relative.type==='crossSchedule'){
        document.getElementById('rb-cross-max').value = editing.relative.maxRepeat || 2;
      } else if(editing.relative.type==='staggeredStart'){
        document.getElementById('rb-staggered-interval').value = editing.relative.intervalMinutes || 15;
      }
    }
  } else {
    fillPersonValueOptions('any');
    fillPositionValueOptions('any');
    updateSlotVisibility('any');
    kindSel.value = 'standard';
    updateKindVisibility();
    relTypeSel.value = 'sequence';
    fillOtherPositionValueOptions('any');
    fillOtherPersonValueOptions('any');
  }
  updateAnyoneFieldsVisibility();
  renderAnyoneTagPicker('rb-anyone-required-chips', selectedRequiredTagIds);
  renderAnyoneTagPicker('rb-anyone-prohibited-chips', selectedProhibitedTagIds);
  renderTagChips();
  updatePreview();

  document.getElementById('rb-submit').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const draft = buildRuleFromForm();
    if(draft.person.mode!=='any' && !draft.person.value){ alert('Choose a specific person or tag.'); return; }
    if(draft.position.mode!=='any' && !draft.position.value){ alert('Choose a specific position or tag.'); return; }
    if(draft.kind==='relative'){
      if(draft.relative.type==='sequence' && draft.relative.otherPosition.mode!=='any' && !draft.relative.otherPosition.value){ alert('Choose the other position for this sequence rule.'); return; }
      if(draft.relative.type==='together' && draft.relative.otherPerson.mode!=='any' && !draft.relative.otherPerson.value){ alert('Choose the other person for this together rule.'); return; }
    }
    const wasEditing = !!editing;
    if(editing) Object.assign(editing, draft);
    else state.rules.push({ id:genId('rule'), ...draft });
    editingRuleId = null;
    if(wasEditing) closeSettings();
    else renderRulesTab();
    renderAll();
  });
  const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('rb-cancel');
  if(cancelBtn) cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ editingRuleId = null; renderRulesTab(); });

  const tbody = document.getElementById('rules-tbody');
  state.rules.forEach(r=>{
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(r))}</td><td>${r.strength}</td><td>${r.active?'yes':'no'}</td>
      <td style="white-space:nowrap;"><button class="db-icon-btn" data-edit-rule="${r.id}">✎</button> <button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-rule="${r.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-rule]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ editingRuleId = btn.dataset.editRule; renderRulesTab(); });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-rule]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if(!confirm('Delete this rule?')) return;
      state.rules = state.rules.filter(r=>r.id!==btn.dataset.delRule);
      if(editingRuleId===btn.dataset.delRule) editingRuleId = null;
      renderRulesTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });

  renderSentenceBuilder(editing);
}

/* ================================================================
   ADVANCED SETTINGS SAVE / LOAD (JSON: roster + tags + time range)
   ================================================================ */
function buildSettingsPayload(){
  return { people: state.people, positions: state.positions, tags: state.tags, settings: state.settings };
}
function exportSettingsJson(){
  try{
    const payload = buildSettingsPayload();
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type:'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = `duty-board-settings-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showToast('Settings saved.');
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e);
    alert('Could not save settings: '+e.message);
  }
}
async function importSettingsJson(file){
  const text = await file.text();
  const payload = JSON.parse(text);
  if(payload.people) state.people = payload.people.map(p=>({ id:p.id, name:p.name, tags:p.tags||[] }));
  if(payload.positions) state.positions = payload.positions.map(normalizePosition);
  if(payload.tags) state.tags = payload.tags;
  if(payload.settings) state.settings = Object.assign({}, state.settings, payload.settings);
  renderAll();
  showToast('Settings loaded.');
}

/* ================================================================
   EXCEL SAVE / LOAD (per schedule tab; loading adds a new tab)
   ================================================================ */
function exportToExcel(){
  if(typeof XLSX==='undefined'){ alert('The spreadsheet library has not finished loading yet — try again in a moment.'); return; }
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  const slots = getSlots();
  const visiblePeople = state.people.filter(p=>!isPersonHidden(p.id));

  const header = ['Person', ...slots.map(s=>s.label)];
  const rows = visiblePeople.map(p=>{
    const row = [p.name];
    for(const s of slots){
      const a = state.assignments.find(a=>a.personId===p.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s.index));
      row.push(a ? positionName(a.positionId) : '');
    }
    return row;
  });
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([header, ...rows]), 'Schedule');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(visiblePeople.map(p=>(
    { id:p.id, name:p.name, tags:p.tags.join(',') }
  ))), 'People');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(state.positions.map(p=>(
    { id:p.id, name:p.name, durationMin:p.durationMin, durationMax:p.durationMax, preferredDuration:p.preferredDuration||p.durationMin,
      singlePerson:p.singlePerson, color:p.color, textColor:p.textColor||'#FFFFFF', tags:p.tags.join(',') }
  ))), 'Positions');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(state.tags.map(t=>(
    { id:t.id, name:t.name, category:t.category, highlightColor:t.highlightColor, textColor:t.textColor }
  ))), 'Tags');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(state.rules.map(r=>({
    id:r.id, nickname:r.nickname||'', strength:r.strength, active:r.active, effect:r.effect||'', kind:r.kind||'standard',
    personMode:r.person ? r.person.mode : '', personValue:(r.person && r.person.value)||'',
    personRequiredTags: r.person && r.person.mode==='any' ? (r.person.requiredTags||[]).join(',') : '',
    personProhibitedTags: r.person && r.person.mode==='any' ? (r.person.prohibitedTags||[]).join(',') : '',
    personCountMin: r.person && r.person.mode==='any' && r.person.count ? r.person.count.min : '',
    personCountMax: r.person && r.person.mode==='any' && r.person.count ? r.person.count.max : '',
    positionMode: r.position ? r.position.mode : '', positionValue:(r.position && r.position.value)||'',
    slotMode: r.slot ? r.slot.mode : '',
    slotValue: r.slot && r.slot.mode==='range' ? `${r.slot.start}-${r.slot.end}` : (r.slot && r.slot.value!==undefined ? r.slot.value : ''),
    relativeType: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative ? r.relative.type||'' : '',
    relOtherPositionMode: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.otherPosition ? r.relative.otherPosition.mode : '',
    relOtherPositionValue: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.otherPosition ? (r.relative.otherPosition.value||'') : '',
    relOtherPersonMode: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.otherPerson ? r.relative.otherPerson.mode : '',
    relOtherPersonValue: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.otherPerson ? (r.relative.otherPerson.value||'') : '',
    relOrder: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.order ? r.relative.order : '',
    relMaxGapMinutes: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && (r.relative.maxGapMinutes!==undefined && r.relative.maxGapMinutes!==null) ? r.relative.maxGapMinutes : '',
    relMeasure: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.measure ? r.relative.measure : '',
    relMaxConsecutive: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.maxConsecutive ? r.relative.maxConsecutive : '',
    relMaxConsecutiveMinutes: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.maxConsecutiveMinutes ? r.relative.maxConsecutiveMinutes : '',
    relMax: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.max ? r.relative.max : '',
    relMaxRepeat: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.maxRepeat ? r.relative.maxRepeat : '',
    relIntervalMinutes: r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && r.relative.intervalMinutes ? r.relative.intervalMinutes : '',
    allowanceMinutes: r.kind==='unfilledAllowance' ? r.minutes : '',
    allowanceScope: r.kind==='unfilledAllowance' ? r.scope : '',
    tags:(r.tags||[]).join(','), note: ruleLabel(r)
  }))), 'Rules');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([
    ['startMinutes','endMinutes'], [state.settings.startMinutes, state.settings.endMinutes]
  ]), 'Settings');

  const sched = activeSchedule();
  XLSX.writeFile(wb, `${(sched.name||'duty-board').replace(/[^a-z0-9-_]+/gi,'-')}.xlsx`);
  showToast('Schedule saved (people toggled off were excluded).');
}

async function importFromExcel(file){
  if(typeof XLSX==='undefined') throw new Error('spreadsheet library not loaded yet');
  const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
  const wb = XLSX.read(buf, { type:'array' });

  if(wb.Sheets['Settings']){
    const s = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Settings'], { header:1 });
    if(s[1] && s[1].length>=2){ state.settings.startMinutes = Number(s[1][0]); state.settings.endMinutes = Number(s[1][1]); }
  }
  if(wb.Sheets['Tags']){
    state.tags = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Tags']).map(r=>({
      id:String(r.id), name:String(r.name), category: r.category==='position' ? 'position' : r.category==='rule' ? 'rule' : 'person',
      highlightColor:r.highlightColor || '#eef1f5', textColor:r.textColor || '#647186'
    }));
  }
  if(wb.Sheets['People']){
    state.people = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['People']).map(r=>({
      id:String(r.id), name:String(r.name),
      tags:String(r.tags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    }));
  }
  if(wb.Sheets['Positions']){
    state.positions = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Positions']).map(r=>{
      const dMin = Number(r.durationMin!==undefined ? r.durationMin : r.durationMinutes) || SLOT_MINUTES;
      const dMax = Number(r.durationMax!==undefined ? r.durationMax : dMin) || dMin;
      const dPref = Number(r.preferredDuration!==undefined ? r.preferredDuration : dMin) || dMin;
      return {
        id:String(r.id), name:String(r.name), durationMin:dMin, durationMax:Math.max(dMin,dMax),
        preferredDuration: Math.min(Math.max(dPref,dMin), Math.max(dMin,dMax)),
        singlePerson: r.singlePerson===true || r.singlePerson==='TRUE' || r.singlePerson==='true',
        color:r.color || '#3b6fd6', textColor:r.textColor || '#FFFFFF',
        tags:String(r.tags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      };
    });
  }

  let newRules = [];
  if(wb.Sheets['Rules']){
    newRules = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Rules']).map(r=>{
      if(r.kind==='unfilledAllowance'){
        const person = { mode:r.personMode||'any', value:r.personValue||null };
        if(person.mode==='any'){
          person.requiredTags = String(r.personRequiredTags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
          person.prohibitedTags = String(r.personProhibitedTags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        }
        return {
          id:String(r.id), nickname:String(r.nickname||''), kind:'unfilledAllowance',
          strength:r.strength==='preferred'?'preferred':'required', effect:r.effect==='forbid'?'forbid':'require',
          active: r.active===true || r.active==='TRUE' || r.active==='true',
          person, minutes: Number(r.allowanceMinutes)||15, scope: r.allowanceScope==='total' ? 'total' : 'perInstance',
          tags:String(r.tags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        };
      }
      let slot;
      if(r.slotMode==='range'){ const [a,b]=String(r.slotValue).split('-').map(Number); slot={mode:'range', start:a, end:b}; }
      else if(r.slotMode==='id'){ slot = {mode:'id', value:Number(r.slotValue)}; }
      else slot = {mode:'any'};

      const kind = r.kind==='relative' ? 'relative' : 'standard';
      let relative = null;
      if(kind==='relative'){
        const relType = r.relativeType || 'sequence';
        relative = { type: relType };
        if(relType==='sequence'){
          relative.otherPosition = { mode: r.relOtherPositionMode||'any', value: r.relOtherPositionValue||null };
          relative.order = (r.relOrder==='before'||r.relOrder==='either') ? r.relOrder : 'after';
          relative.maxGapMinutes = (r.relMaxGapMinutes!==undefined && r.relMaxGapMinutes!=='') ? Number(r.relMaxGapMinutes) : null;
        } else if(relType==='together'){
          relative.otherPerson = { mode: r.relOtherPersonMode||'any', value: r.relOtherPersonValue||null };
        } else if(relType==='consecutive'){
          relative.measure = r.relMeasure==='minutes' ? 'minutes' : 'count';
          relative.maxConsecutive = Number(r.relMaxConsecutive)||2;
          relative.maxConsecutiveMinutes = Number(r.relMaxConsecutiveMinutes)||30;
        } else if(relType==='totalLimit'){
          relative.measure = r.relMeasure==='minutes' ? 'minutes' : 'count';
          relative.max = Number(r.relMax) || (relative.measure==='minutes'?45:2);
        } else if(relType==='crossSchedule'){
          relative.maxRepeat = Number(r.relMaxRepeat)||2;
        } else if(relType==='staggeredStart'){
          relative.intervalMinutes = Number(r.relIntervalMinutes)||15;
        }
        // 'swap' has no extra fields
      }
      const person = { mode:r.personMode||'any', value:r.personValue||null };
      if(person.mode==='any'){
        person.requiredTags = String(r.personRequiredTags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        person.prohibitedTags = String(r.personProhibitedTags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        if(r.personCountMin!==undefined && r.personCountMin!=='') person.count = { min:Number(r.personCountMin)||1, max:Number(r.personCountMax)||1 };
      }
      return {
        id:String(r.id), nickname:String(r.nickname||''), kind, strength:r.strength==='preferred'?'preferred':'required',
        active: r.active===true || r.active==='TRUE' || r.active==='true',
        effect:r.effect==='require'?'require':'forbid',
        person,
        position:{ mode:r.positionMode||'any', value:r.positionValue||null },
        slot, relative,
        tags:String(r.tags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      };
    });
  }

  let newAssignments = [];
  if(wb.Sheets['Schedule']){
    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Schedule'], { header:1 });
    for(let r=1; r<rows.length; r++){
      const row = rows[r];
      if(!row || !row.length) continue;
      const person = state.people.find(p=>p.name===row[0]);
      if(!person) continue;
      for(let col=1; col<row.length; col++){
        const posName = row[col];
        if(!posName) continue;
        const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.name===posName);
        if(!pos) continue;
        const startSlot = col-1;
        const alreadyCovered = newAssignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(startSlot));
        if(alreadyCovered) continue;
        newAssignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:person.id, positionId:pos.id, startSlot, slotCount:positionDurationSlots(pos.id) });
      }
    }
  }

  const importedName = (file && file.name) ? file.name.replace(/\.xlsx$/i,'') : `Imported ${state.schedules.length+1}`;
  const sched = createSchedule(importedName, { assignments:newAssignments, rules:newRules, rejectedSuggestions:new Set() });
  setActiveSchedule(sched.id);
  showToast('Schedule loaded as a new tab (rightmost).');
}

/* ================================================================
   INIT
   ================================================================ */
function init(){
  loadPersisted();

  // Move the overlay/floating/toast layers to be direct children of <body>, so their
  // `position:fixed` is always relative to the real viewport rather than to whatever
  // Quarto wraps this document's content in — otherwise scrolling can leave menus
  // rendering underneath the page title or a sticky nav bar. z-index alone (see CSS)
  // covers the rest of that same issue.
  ['settings-overlay','floating-layer','toast-layer','help-overlay'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if(el && el.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-settings').addEventListener('click', ()=>openSettings('people'));
  document.getElementById('btn-close-settings').addEventListener('click', closeSettings);
  document.getElementById('settings-overlay').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target.id==='settings-overlay') closeSettings(); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-modal-tab').forEach(t=>t.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ editingRuleId = null; tagsTabFilter = 'all'; switchModalTab(t.dataset.tab); }));

  document.getElementById('btn-help').addEventListener('click', openHelp);
  document.getElementById('btn-close-help').addEventListener('click', closeHelp);
  document.getElementById('help-overlay').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target.id==='help-overlay') closeHelp(); });
  try{
    if(!localStorage.getItem(HELP_SEEN_KEY)) document.getElementById('btn-help').classList.add('pulse-attention');
  }catch(e){ /* localStorage unavailable — skip the first-visit pulse */ }

  document.getElementById('btn-solve').addEventListener('click', openSolveMenu);
  document.getElementById('btn-xlsx-menu').addEventListener('click', openXlsxMenu);
  document.getElementById('file-input').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if(file) importFromExcel(file).catch(err=>{ console.error(err); alert('Could not read that file: '+err.message); });
    e.target.value = '';
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-undo').addEventListener('click', undo);

  document.getElementById('btn-settings-save').addEventListener('click', exportSettingsJson);
  document.getElementById('btn-settings-load').addEventListener('click', ()=>document.getElementById('settings-file-input').click());
  document.getElementById('settings-file-input').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if(file) importSettingsJson(file).catch(err=>{ console.error(err); alert('Could not read that file: '+err.message); });
    e.target.value = '';
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-toggle-tags').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    showPersonTags = !showPersonTags;
    document.getElementById('btn-toggle-tags').textContent = `👤 Person tags: ${showPersonTags ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
    renderChart();
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-toggle-lock-display').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    lockDisplayMode = !lockDisplayMode;
    document.getElementById('btn-toggle-lock-display').textContent = `🔒 Lock display: ${lockDisplayMode ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
    document.getElementById('duty-board').classList.toggle('lock-display-on', lockDisplayMode);
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-full-view').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    fullViewMode = !fullViewMode;
    document.getElementById('btn-full-view').textContent = fullViewMode ? 'Full view: on' : 'Full view';
    renderChart();
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', ()=>{ syncRightColumnHeight(); if(fullViewMode) renderChart(); });

  function toggleFullscreenOn(elId){
    const el = document.getElementById(elId);
    const requestFn = el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen || el.msRequestFullscreen;
    const exitFn = document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen || document.msExitFullscreen;
    try{
      if(!document.fullscreenElement && requestFn) requestFn.call(el).catch(()=>{});
      else if(document.fullscreenElement && exitFn) exitFn.call(document);
    }catch(err){ /* fullscreen not supported in this environment */ }
  }
  document.getElementById('btn-fullscreen').addEventListener('click', ()=>toggleFullscreenOn('duty-board'));
  document.getElementById('btn-chart-fullscreen').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(!document.fullscreenElement){
      fullViewMode = true;
      document.getElementById('btn-full-view').textContent = 'Full view: on';
      renderChart();
    }
    toggleFullscreenOn('chart-panel');
  });
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', ()=>{
    const fsBtn = document.getElementById('btn-fullscreen');
    const chartFsBtn = document.getElementById('btn-chart-fullscreen');
    const fsEl = document.fullscreenElement;
    if(fsBtn) fsBtn.textContent = (fsEl && fsEl.id==='duty-board') ? '⤢' : '⛶';
    if(chartFsBtn) chartFsBtn.textContent = (fsEl && fsEl.id==='chart-panel') ? '⤢' : '⛶';
    renderChart();
  });

  ['rule-search','filter-person','filter-position','filter-time','filter-rule-tag','filter-required','filter-preferred','filter-inactive'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.addEventListener('input', renderRules);
    el.addEventListener('change', renderRules);
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if(e.key==='Escape') closeFloating();
    if((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase()==='z' && !e.repeat){
      e.preventDefault();
      undo();
    }
  });

  renderAll();
}

init();
</script>
```
